description.en: Average monthly concentration of key air pollutants.
description.ms: Kepekatan purata bulanan bahan pencemar udara utama.

methodology.en: This dataset presents monthly concentrations of various air pollutants, including carbon monoxide (CO), nitrogen dioxide (NO²), ozone (O³), particulate matter (PM₁₀, PM₂.₅), and sulfur dioxide (SO²). The data is tabulated from hourly observational data collected from monitoring stations across Malaysia.
methodology.ms: Set data ini mengandungi kepekatan bulanan pelbagai bahan pencemar udara, termasuk karbon monoksida (CO), nitrogen dioksida (NO²), ozon (O³), zarah terampai (PM₁₀, PM₂.₅), dan sulfur dioksida (SO²). Data ini dihasilkan daripada data pengawasan secara jam yang dikumpulkan dari stesen pemantauan di seluruh Malaysia.

caveats.en: A small minority of values in 2017 are null due to inavailability of data.
caveats.ms: Sebahagian kecil nilai bagi tahun 2017 tidak dapat dibekalkan disebabkan ketiadaan data.

description.en: This dataset provides information on astronomical phenomena observable from Malaysia, including the phases of the Moon, the Moon's perigee and apogee, Earth's perihelion and aphelion, meteor showers, planetary elongations, the solstices, equinoxes, and other related astronomical events. The data are calculated using Kuala Lumpur as the reference location and Malaysia Time (MYT, UTC+8), based on internationally recognized astronomical sources. This almanac is intended to support astronomical observations, education, and the planning of astronomy-related activities.
description.ms: Set data ini menyediakan maklumat fenomena astronomi yang dapat dicerap di Malaysia, termasuk fasa Bulan, perigee dan apogee Bulan, perihelion dan aphelion Bumi, hujan meteor, elongasi planet, solstis, ekuinoks serta fenomena berkaitan. Data dikira berdasarkan lokasi rujukan Kuala Lumpur dan Waktu Piawai Malaysia (MYT, UTC+8) menggunakan sumber astronomi yang diiktiraf. Almanak ini digunakan bagi tujuan pencerapan, pendidikan dan perancangan aktiviti astronomi.

methodology.en: This Astronomical Almanac has been produced by the Malaysian Space Agency (MYSA) through astronomical calculations and simulations using professional software such as TheSkyX and Stellarium to determine the positions of celestial bodies based on the geographical coordinates of Kuala Lumpur. The generated data are subsequently reviewed and validated by comparison with internationally and locally recognized astronomical reference sources to ensure their accuracy and reliability. The Astronomical Almanac serves as an annual reference that provides information on astronomical phenomena to support observation and educational activities, while promoting greater public understanding of astronomical events and space science in Malaysia.
methodology.ms: Data Almanak Astronomi ini dihasilkan oleh Agensi Angkasa Malaysia (MYSA) melalui pengiraan dan simulasi astronomi menggunakan perisian profesional seperti TheSkyX dan Stellarium bagi menentukan kedudukan jasad samawi berdasarkan koordinat geografi Kuala Lumpur. Data yang dijana kemudiannya disemak dan disahkan melalui perbandingan dengan sumber rujukan astronomi yang diiktiraf di peringkat antarabangsa dan tempatan bagi memastikan ketepatan serta kebolehpercayaan maklumat. Almanak Astronomi ini berfungsi sebagai rujukan tahunan yang menyediakan maklumat mengenai fenomena astronomi untuk menyokong aktiviti pencerapan dan pendidikan serta meningkatkan pemahaman masyarakat terhadap fenomena angkasa di Malaysia.

caveats.en: The information presented in this Astronomical Almanac is provided as a reference based on astronomical calculations and computer simulations. The timing and visibility of astronomical phenomena are based on the specified reference location and may vary depending on the observer's geographical location, particularly between Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah, and Sarawak. These geographical differences may affect the rise and set times of celestial bodies, their apparent positions in the sky, and the duration for which the phenomena remain observable. In addition, the actual visibility of astronomical phenomena is influenced by atmospheric conditions and environmental factors such as weather, cloud cover, haze, atmospheric transparency, and the level of light pollution. These factors may reduce visibility or prevent observations altogether, even when the phenomena occur as predicted.
caveats.ms: Maklumat dalam Almanak Astronomi ini disediakan sebagai rujukan berdasarkan pengiraan astronomi dan simulasi komputer. Waktu serta kenampakan sesuatu fenomena astronomi adalah berdasarkan lokasi rujukan yang dinyatakan dan mungkin berbeza mengikut kedudukan geografi, khususnya antara Semenanjung Malaysia, Sabah dan Sarawak. Perbezaan ini boleh mempengaruhi waktu terbit atau terbenam objek samawi, kedudukannya di langit serta tempoh fenomena dapat dicerap. Selain itu, kenampakan sebenar fenomena astronomi turut dipengaruhi oleh keadaan atmosfera dan faktor persekitaran seperti cuaca, litupan awan, jerebu, ketelusan atmosfera serta tahap pencemaran cahaya, yang boleh menjejaskan atau menghalang pencerapan walaupun fenomena tersebut berlaku seperti yang diramalkan.

description.en: Release date and metadata for all DOSM's publications in 2026.
description.ms: Tarikh penerbitan serta metadata bagi semua penerbitan DOSM dalam tahun 2026.

methodology.en: DOSM's [advance release calendar](https://www.dosm.gov.my/portal-main/arc) is compiled and coordinated by the Strategic Communications Division for the purpose of display on the main DOSM portal. It contains three fields, namely the title in English, title in Malay, and release date. To produce the structured dataset shown here, the OpenDOSM team conducts standardisation of naming conventions and adds several metadata fields which are typically helpful for users, such as category, frequency, and release series (in date and natural language formats).
methodology.ms: [Kalendar Keluaran Awal](https://www.dosm.gov.my/portal-main/arc) DOSM disusun dan diselaras oleh Bahagian Komunikasi Strategik bagi tujuan paparan di portal utama DOSM. Ia mengangundi tiga medan, iaitu tajuk dalam Bahasa Inggeris, tajuk dalam Bahasa Melayu, serta tarikh penerbitan. Untuk mewujudkan set data berstruktur yang dipaparkan di sini, pasukan OpenDOSM melakasanakan penyeragaman konvensyen penamaan dan tambah beberapa medan metadata yang biasanya membantu pengguna data seperti kategori, frekuensi, serta siri penerbitan (dalam format tarikh dan bahasa semulajadi).

publications.en:
The data shown here tallies exactly with the [Upcoming Publications calendar](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/upcoming) on OpenDOSM. Furthermore, to facilitate integration of this data, we have made the dataset available as:
- A [public Google Calendar](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/embed?src=u89n9ehgt51hs5lj5m2pc49h9c834ta2%40import.calendar.google.com&ctz=Asia%2FKuala_Lumpur) which you can add to your own Google Calendar.
- An iCalendar (.ics) file which you can [download](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/meta/arc_en.ics) and add to the calendar application of your choice.
publications.ms:
Data yang dipaparkan di sini adalah konsisten sepenuhnya dengan [kalendar Penerbitan Akan Datang](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/upcoming) di OpenDOSM. Selain itu, untuk memudahkan integrasi data ini, kami telah menerbitkan data ini sebagai:
- [Kalendar Google](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/embed?src=8per1gs0brb1b2igj2mi28bhgpou789g%40import.calendar.google.com&ctz=Asia%2FKuala_Lumpur) yang boleh ditambah ke kalendar Google anda.
- Fail iCalendar (.ics) yang boleh [dimuat turun](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/meta/arc_bm.ics) dan ditambah ke aplikasi kalendar pilihan anda.

description.en: Monthly foreign arrivals in Malaysia by nationality and sex.
description.ms: Kemasukan warga asing secara bulanan ke Malaysia mengikut kewarganegaraan dan jantina.

methodology.en: The Immigration Department of Malaysia operates the Malaysian Immigration System (MyIMMs), which is used to record arrivals and departures by air, land, and sea at all international points of entry to Malaysia. The dataset shown here is aggregated from the transactional data stored in MyIMMs, which is the single source of truth for movement in and out of Malaysia.
methodology.ms: Jabatan Imigresen Malaysia mengendalikan Sistem Imigresen Malaysia (MyIMMs), yang digunakan untuk merekodkan ketibaan dan pelepasan melalui udara, darat dan laut di semua pintu masuk antarabangsa ke Malaysia. Set data ini diagregatkan daripada data transaksi yang disimpan dalam MyIMMs, iaitu sumber tunggal bagi pergerakan masuk dan keluar dari Malaysia.

caveats.en: This data is based solely on records in MyIMMS. Furthermore, it should be noted that approximately 0.01% of arrivals do not have a nationality specified, including stateless individuals and refugees.
caveats.ms: Data ini hanya berdasarkan rekod dalam MyIMMs. Selain itu, tiada kewarganegaraan yang direkodkan bagi ~0.01% daripada kemasukan keseluruhan, termasuk individu tanpa kerakyatan _(stateless)_ dan pelarian _(refugee)_.

publications.en: Our site features a [dashboard on immigration](https://data.gov.my/dashboard/immigration) where you can explore this data in a more interactive manner.
publications.ms: Portal ini memaparkan [papan pemuka tentang imigresen](https://data.gov.my/dashboard/immigration) di mana anda boleh menerokai data ini dengan lebih interaktif.

description.en: This table provides a lookup for codes under the Broad Economic Categories (BEC) classification, as applied and used by publications in Malaysia. The BEC is primarily used by the Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM), for instance when categorising and analysing imports by end-use.
description.ms: Jadual ini memberi rujukan bagi kod yang terkandung dalam penjenisan Kategori Ekonomi Umum (BEC), seperti yang digunapakai dalam penerbitan data di Malaysia. BEC digunakan terutamanya oleh Jabatan Perangkaan Malaysia (DOSM), misalnya dalam mengkategorikan dan menganalisa data import mengikut penggunaan akhir.

methodology.en: The BEC used in Malaysia is based on the [BEC published by the United Nations Statistics Division](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/trade/classifications/bec.asp), which provides a framework for classifying internationally traded goods by their broad economic end-use. The code 000 does not exist in the international version, but is included here for analytical ease to indicate overall values.
methodology.ms: BEC yang digunapakai di Malaysia adalah berdasarkan [BEC yang diterbitkan oleh Bahagian Statistik Pertubuhan Bangsa-bangsa Bersatu](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/trade/classifications/bec.asp), yang menyediakan rangka kerja untuk mengklasifikasikan barangan dagangan antarabangsa mengikut penggunaan akhir ekonomi. Kod 000 tidak wujud dalam versi antarabangsa, tetapi disertakan di sini untuk kemudahan analisis, khususnya untuk menunjukkan nilai keseluruhan.

description.en: Number of people born daily in Malaysia, based on registrations with JPN from 1920 to the present.
description.ms: Jumlah orang yang lahir secara harian di Malaysia, berdasarkan pendaftaran dengan JPN dari 1920 sehingga kini.

methodology.en: This dataset tabulates the number of people born in Malaysia and registered with JPN from 1920 to the present.
methodology.ms: Set data ini menunjukkan jumlah orang yang lahir di Malaysia dan didaftarkan dengan JPN daripada 1920 sehingga kini.

caveats.en:
There are several nuances to bear in mind when using this data:
 1. The data is derived based on births registerd with JPN. Accordingly, if a birth is not registered with JPN (for instance, if a foreigner chooses to register their child in their home country, or if a resident in a remote area does not register the birth of their child), it will not count in this dataset.
 2. This dataset tabulate births for each day of birth, rather than the date of registration with JPN. Therefore, to ensure accuracy, the data is provided with a 1 month lag, since most people do not register their child on the exact day they are born.
 3. Data for past dates may be revised in future updates; this represents people registering children outside a 1 month window from their date of birth. However, our update procedure should ensure that there is no significant change to the trend.
caveats.ms:
Terdapat beberapa nuansa yang perlu diambilkira semasa menggunakan data ini.
 1. Data ini dihasilkan berdasarkan kelahiran yang didaftarkan dengan JPN. Oleh itu, sekiranya kelahiran itu tidak didaftarkan dengan JPN (contohnya sekiranya rakyat asing hanya mendaftar kelahiran anaknya di negara asal, ataupun penduduk di kawasan yang sangat terpencil belum mendaftarkan anaknya) maka ia tidak terkandung dalam set data ini.
 2. Set data ini memaparkan jumlah kelahiran berdasarkan tarikh lahir dan bukannya tarikh pendaftaran dengan JPN. Oleh itu, bagi memastikan ketepatan data, set data ini dibekalkan dengan lag 1 bulan, memandankan kebayankan orang tidak mendaftarkan anak mereka sejurus mereka dilahirkan.
 3. Data bagi tarikh-tarikh lepas mungkin akan dikemaskini pada masa depan; ini menunjukkan orang mendaftarkan anak mereka di luar tempoh 1 bulan daripada tarikh kelahiran. Namun, piawaian kemaskini kami biasanya akan memastikan tiada perubahan signifikan pada tren.

title.en: Daily Blood Donations by Blood Group
title.ms: Pendermaan Darah Harian mengikut Kumpulan Darah

description.en: Daily blood donations at national level for each of the 4 major blood groups. The table provides a preview of the dataset using the most recent 2 years of data.
description.ms: Pendermaan darah harian di peringkat nasional bagi setiap daripada 4 kumpulan darah utama. Jadual memberi pratonton kepada set data dengan menggunakan data daripada 2 tahun terkini.

methodology.en: This dataset is produced from transactional data recorded in the Blood Bank Information System (BBISv2), a vein-to-vein blood-tracking system used by 22 main blood collection sites under MoH which covers the majority of blood donations in Malaysia.
methodology.ms: Dataset ini dihasilkan oleh Sistem Informasi Pusat Darah (BBISv2) di Kementerian Kesihatan Malaysia, berdasarkan survelan harian di lapangan yang dilaksanakan untuk memantau evolusi derma darah di Malaysia kecuali di Negeri Perlis, Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya, dan Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan.

caveats.en: The true number of daily blood donations is higher than the number recorded in this dataset, which does not reflect donations made at locations other than the 22 main sites integrated with BBISv2. However, the 22 main sites cover the large majority of blood donations in Malaysia (~80%), and therefore provide a representative view of blood donation trends.
caveats.ms: Bilangan sebenar derma darah harian adalah lebih tinggi daripada bilangan yang direkodkan dalam set data ini, kerana set data ini tidak mengambil kira pendermaan yang dibuat di lokasi selain daripada 22 pusat pungutan darah utama yang disepadukan dengan BBISv2. title.en: Daily Blood Donations by Blood Group & State
title.ms: Pendermaan Darah Harian mengikut Kumpulan Darah & Negeri

description.en: Daily blood donations at state level for each of the 4 major blood groups. The table provides a preview of the dataset using the most recent year of data.
description.ms: Pendermaan darah harian di peringkat negeri bagi setiap daripada 4 kumpulan darah utama. Jadual memberi pratonton kepada set data dengan menggunakan data daripada tahun terkini.

methodology.en: This dataset is produced from transactional data recorded in the Blood Bank Information System (BBISv2), a vein-to-vein blood-tracking system used by 22 main blood collection sites under MoH which covers the majority of blood donations in Malaysia.
methodology.ms: Dataset ini dihasilkan oleh Sistem Informasi Pusat Darah (BBISv2) di Kementerian Kesihatan Malaysia, berdasarkan survelan harian di lapangan yang dilaksanakan untuk memantau evolusi derma darah di Malaysia kecuali di Negeri Perlis, Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya, dan Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan.

caveats.en:
The true number of daily blood donations is higher than the number recorded in this dataset, which does not reflect donations made at locations other than the 22 main sites integrated with BBISv2. However, the 22 main sites cover the large majority of blood donations in Malaysia (~80%), and therefore provide a representative view of blood donation trends. Furthermore, it should be noted that:

- The data for W.P. Kuala Lumpur includes all donations made in W.P. Putrajaya, and all donations made at mobile campaigns (e.g. at shopping malls, universities, stadiums, etc) around Selangor. Accordingly, analysis of blood donor rates by state should treat the Klang Valley as a single group comprising 3 states.
- Data for Perlis and W.P. Labuan is not available for now, because there are no blood donation centres in those states integrated with BBISv2 yet.
caveats.ms:
Bilangan sebenar derma darah harian adalah lebih tinggi daripada bilangan yang direkodkan dalam set data ini, kerana set data ini tidak mengambil kira pendermaan yang dibuat di lokasi selain daripada 22 pusat pungutan darah utama yang disepadukan dengan BBISv2. Walau bagaimanapun, 22 pusat utama meliputi majoriti pendermaan darah di Malaysia (~80%), maka memberi gambaran yang tepat mengenai trend pendermaan darah. Tambahan, perlu diambil perhatian bahawa:

- Data bagi W.P. Kuala Lumpur merangkumi semua pendermaan di W.P. Putrajaya, serta semua pendermaan di kempen bergerak (contohnya di pusat membeli belah, universiti, stadium, dsb) di seluruh Selangor. Oleh itu, analisis mengenai kadar pendermaan darah mengikut negeri harus melihat Lembah Klang sebagai satu unit yang terdiri daripada 3 negeri.
- Data bagi Perlis dan W.P. Labuan tidak dibekalkan buat masa ini, kerana belum ada pusat pungutan darah di negeri tersebut yang disepadukan dengan sistem BBISv2.

description.en: Overall balance of the 4 main components of Malaysia's balance of payments (BOP).
description.ms: Baki keseluruhan 4 komponen utama dalam imbangan pembayaran (BOP) Malaysia.

methodology.en: In general, Malaysia's balance of payments (BOP) record all international economic transactions between Malaysia and other nations. This dataset presents the overall balance of the main components of Malaysia's BOP, that is the current account, capital account, financial account, and official reserve account. It is compiled based on the IMF's BPM6 guidelines. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/bop-technotes).
methodology.ms: Secara am, imbangan pembayaran (BOP) Malaysia memaparkan transaksi ekonomi antarabangsa antara Malaysia dengan negara lain di dunia. Set data ini memaparkan baki keselurun bagi komponen utama BOP, iaitu akaun semasa, akaun modal, akaun kewangan, serta akaun rizab rasmi. Segala statistik BOP disusun berdasarkan garis panduan BMP6 yang diterbitkan oleh IMF. Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/bop-technotes).

caveats.en: Values for the most recent 8 quarters may be revised in future releases.
caveats.ms: Angka bagi 8 suku terkini mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan akan datang.

publications.en: [Balance of Payments, 3Q 2024](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/bop_2024-q3), the latest edition of the quarterly BOP statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on BOP](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/balance-of-payments) which enables you to explore Malaysia's BOP data interactively.

description.ms: Peratusan pelajar yang menamatkan pendidikan rendah, menengah rendah, dan menengah atas di peringkat nasional dan negeri.

methodology.en: This dataset is derived from administrative records maintained by the Ministry of Education Malaysia via the Education Management Information System (EMIS). Completion rates are calculated by comparing the number of students who complete a given education level with the total cohort that started that level.
methodology.ms: Dataset ini diperolehi daripada rekod pentadbiran yang dikendalikan oleh Kementerian Pendidikan Malaysia melalui Sistem Pengurusan Maklumat Pendidikan (EMIS). Kadar tamat pengajian dikira dengan membandingkan bilangan pelajar yang selesai bagi tahap pendidikan tertentu dengan jumlah kohort yang memulakan tahap tersebut.

caveats.en: Because Malaysia's dropout rates are extremely low, completion rates may exceed 100% due to a small number of students repeating grades or transferring between states. Furthermore, it should be noted that the data refers to government schools only.
caveats.ms: Oleh sebab kadar 'dropout' di Malaysia amat rendah, kadar tamat pengajian mungkin melebihi 100% disebabkan sebilangan kecil pelajar yang mengulang gredi atau berpindah antara negeri. Tambahan, data ini merujuk kepada sekolah kerajaan sahaja.

description.en: Complete list of comsetic products notified to and approved by the Drug Control Authority. The table provides a preview of the dataset using 10 records as a sample.
description.ms: Senarai penuh produk kosmetik yang telah dihantar notifikasi dan diluluskan oleh Pihak Berkuasa Kawalan Dadah. Jadual memberi pratonton kepada set data dengan menggunakan 10 rekod sebagai contoh.

methodology.en: In accordance with the Control of Drugs and Cosmetics Regulations 1984, all pharmaceutical, health and personal care products marketed in Malaysia must be registered and approved by the Drug Control Authority (DCA). For cosmetics specifically, a 'notification' must be submitted to NPRA via the QUEST3+ system, which is the administrative system used by NPRA to enable the online management of product registrations, variations, licensing, market sampling, renewal and others. This dataset is an exact copy of the administrative record of cosmetic products with approved notifications, with any columns containing personal data excluded.
methodology.ms: Selaras dengan Peraturan Kawalan Dadah dan Kosmetik 1984, semua produk farmaseutikal, kesihatan, dan penjagaan peribadi yang dipasarkan di Malaysia mesti didaftarkan dan diluluskan oleh Pihak Berkuasa Kawalan Dadah. Bagi produk kosmetik khususnya, satu 'notifikasi' perlu dihantar ke NPRA melalui sistem QUEST3+, iaitu sistem pentadbiran yang digunakan oleh NPRA untuk membolehkan pengurusan dalam talian bagi pendaftaran produk, variasi, pelesenan, pensampelan pasaran, pembaharuan, dan lain-lain. Set data ini adalah salinan rekod pentadbiran produk kosmetik yang diluluskan notifikasinya, dengan mana-mana medan yang mengandungi data peribadi dikecualikan.

caveats.en: Although this data represents administrative records, it nevertheless remains a static dataset which is updated once per day, rather than in real time. As such, this dataset should not be used as the basis for any legal action. Any queries on enforcement of the relevant laws of Malaysia should always be referred to the National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency (NPRA).
caveats.ms: Walaupun set data ini adalah data pentadbiran, ia masih merupakan set data statik yang dikemaskini sekali sehari dan bukkannya dalam masa sebenar (_real time_). Oleh itu, set data ini tidak harus digunakan sebagai asas untuk sebarang tindakan undang-undang. Sebarang pertanyaan mengenai penguatkuasaan undang-undang Malaysia yang berkaitan harus dirujuk kepada Bahagian Regulatori Farmasi Negara (NPRA).

methodology.en: This dataset is produced by the Crisis Preparedness and Response Centre (CPRC) at the Ministry of Health, based on daily ground-level surveillance conducted to monitor the evolution of COVID-19 in Malaysia. Following Malaysia's transition to endemicity, the public reporting frequency was altered from daily to weekly. Nevertheless, internal surveillance is still conducted on a daily basis.

Berikutan peralihan Malaysia kepada fasa endemik, kekerapan pelaporan awam telah diubah daripada harian kepada mingguan. Walau bagaimanapun,  pemantauan dalaman masih dijalankan secara harian.

caveats.en: In general, the data presented here is based on the date of report rather than the date of the event.

description.ms: Kes COVID-19 harian di peringkat kebangsaan dan negeri, dengan pecahan mengikut kumpulan umur.

methodology.en: Building on the [base dataset](https://data.moh.gov.my/data-catalogue/healthcare_covid_cases), this dataset tabules new COVID-19 cases by age either based on the individual's IC number (for Malaysians with an IC number) or based on the age declared in the COVID-19 test result declaration (for cases without an IC number or non-Malaysians).
methodology.ms: Berdasarkan [set data asas](https://data.moh.gov.my/data-catalogue/healthcare_covid_cases), set data ini memaparkan kes COVID-19 baharu mengikut kumpulan umur berdasarkan nombor kad pengenalan (untuk warganegara Malaysia yang memiliki KP) ataupun berdasarkan umur dalam pengisytiharan keputusan ujian COVID-19 (untuk kes tanpa nombor KP atau kes bukan warganegara).

caveats.en: In a small minority (~1.5%) of cases, no age was declared or able to be derived. As such, the total number of cases derived from summing the cases for all age groups in this dataset will be less than the number of cases in the [base dataset](https://data.moh.gov.my/data-catalogue/healthcare_covid_cases).
caveats.ms: Bagi sebilangan kecil kes (~1.5%), medan umur tidak dinyatakan. Oleh itu, jumlah bagi kumpulan umur dalam set data ini adalah kurang daripada jumlah kes dalam [set data asas](https://data.moh.gov.my/data-catalogue/healthcare_covid_cases).

title.en: Daily COVID-19 Cases by Vaccination Status & State
title.ms: Kes COVID-19 Harian mengikut Status Vaksinasi & Negeri

description.en: Daily COVID-19 cases at national and state level, broken down by vaccination status.
description.ms: Kes COVID-19 harian di peringkat kebangsaan dan negeri, dengan pecahan mengikut status vaksinasi.

methodology.en: Building on the [base dataset](https://data.moh.gov.my/data-catalogue/healthcare_covid_cases), this dataset tabules new COVID-19 cases by vaccination status by deterministically matching individual-level COVID-19 case data with COVID-19 vaccination records from the Malaysian Vaccine Administration System (MyVAS). Matching is done using the individual's IC/BC number (for Malaysians) or passport (for non-Malaysians), with only exact matches permitted.
methodology.ms: Berdasarkan [set data asas](https://data.moh.gov.my/data-catalogue/healthcare_covid_cases), set data ini memaparkan kes COVID-19 baharu mengikut status vaksin melalui pemadanan data kes COVID-19 peringkat individu dengan rekod vaksinasi COVID-19 daripada Sistem Pentadbiran Vaksin Malaysia (MyVAS). Pemadanan dilakukan menggunakan nombor kad pengenalan / sijil kelahiran (untuk warganegara Malaysia) ataupun nombor pasport (untuk bukan warganegara), dengan hanya padanan 100% diterima.

caveats.en: It is possible that the number of vaccinated cases exceeds the tabulated number, for instance if an individual was vaccinated under an ID different from the ID used in the COVID-19 test result declaration, or if an individual was vaccinated outside the country and has not yet uploaded their records to MyVAS. However, these issues are negligible in magnitude.
caveats.ms: Ada kemungkinan bahawa bilangan kes yang divaksinasi melebihi bilangan yang rekod yang dapat dipadankan, contohnya jika seseorang individu telah divaksin di bawah ID yang berbeza daripada ID yang digunakan dalam pengisytiharan keputusan ujian COVID-19, ataupun jika seseorang individu telah divaksin di luar negara dan belum memuat naik rekod mereka ke MyVAS. Walau bagaimanapun, isu-isu ini tidak signifikan secara keseluruhan.

title.en: Transactional Records: Deaths due to COVID-19
title.ms: Rekod Transaksi: Kematian disebabkan oleh COVID-19

description.en: Transactional records of deaths due to COVID-19, with various demographic and medical dimensions including COVID-19 vaccination records. The preview shows the most recent 200 records.
description.ms: Rekod transaksi kematian disebabkan oleh COVID-19, dengan pelbagai dimensi demografi dan perubatan termasuk rekod vaksinasi COVID-19. Pratonton menunjukkan 200 rekod terkini.

methodology.en: This dataset is produced by the Crisis Preparedness and Response Centre (CPRC) at the Ministry of Health, based on daily ground-level surveillance conducted to monitor the evolution of COVID-19 in Malaysia. Following Malaysia's transition to endemicity, the public reporting frequency was altered from daily to weekly. Nevertheless, internal surveillance is still conducted on a daily basis.
methodology.ms: Dataset ini dihasilkan oleh Pusat Kesiapsiagaan dan Tindak Cepat Krisis (CPRC) di Kementerian Kesihatan Malaysia, berdasarkan survelan harian di lapangan yang dilaksanakan untuk memantau evolusi COVID-19 di Malaysia. Berikutan peralihan Malaysia kepada fasa endemik, kekerapan pelaporan awam telah diubah daripada harian kepada mingguan. Namun begitu, survelan harian masih berlangunsung secara dalaman.

caveats.en: As a general rule, deaths due to COVID-19 are not announced on the day that the death occurs. This is because it takes time to medically verify cause of death (via autopsy), as well as to register the death in accordance with the laws of Malaysia. Therefore, there may be future records where the date of death is prior to records already in the dataset. Phrased differently, aggregation based on the date of death will produce a dynamic dataset, where the number of deaths for a certain date may increase in future.
caveats.ms: Secara am, kematian disebabkan oleh COVID-19 tidak diumumkan pada tarikh kematian tersebut berlaku. Ini kerana ia memerlukan masa untuk mengesahkan sebab kematian (melalui bedah siasat), serta untuk mendaftarkan kematian tersebut selaras dengan undang-undang Malaysia. Oleh itu, terdapat kemungkinan di mana rekod yang dimasukkan pada masa depan mempunyai tarikh kematian sebelum rekod yang sudah ada dalam set data. Dalam erti kata lain, pengagretan berdasarkan tarikh kematian akan menghasilkan set data yang dinamik, di mana bilangan kematian pada sesuatu tarikh mungkin meningkat pada masa depan.

description.en: National-level CPI at group granularity. The table below provides a preview of the full dataset using the latest month of data only.
description.ms: IHP peringkat nasional dengan perincian tahap kumpulan. Jadual di bawah memberi pratonton kepada set data penuh dengan menggunakan data bulan terkini sahaja.

methodology.en: The CPI measures the cost of purchasing a constant, representative 'basket' of goods and services. The quantity and quality of goods in the basket are kept constant, so that changes in the cost of the basket are purely due to price changes. The changes in the cost of this basket represent the rate of inflation. For a deeper understanding of the price collection and CPI computation methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/cpi-technotes). Finally, it should be noted that Malaysia's CPI classification is deliberately consistent with the United Nations Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP) to ensure international comparability.
methodology.ms: IHP mengukur kos pembelian bagi 'bakul' tetap barangan dan perkhidmatan yang mewakili corak purata pembelian penduduk Malaysia. Kualiti dan kuantiti item dalam bakul ini tidak berubah, maka perubahan kos bakul ini disebabkan oleh perubahan harga sahaja. Perubahan kos bakul inilah yang mewakili kadar inflasi. Untuk mendapat pemahaman yang lebih mendalam tentang metodologi pemungutan harga dan perangkaan IHP, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/cpi-technotes). Akhirnya, sila ambil maklum bahawa klasifikasi IHP Malaysia dipastikan konsisten dengan United Nations Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP) demi membolehkan perbandingan antarabangsa.

caveats.en: When interpreting inflation rates derived from the CPI, it is important to remember that the rate of inflation experienced by a specific individual may be higher or lower than this number. This does not invalidate the CPI, which is meant to be an average value representative of the entire population.
caveats.ms: Dalam mentafsirkan kadar inflasi yang dihasilkan berdasarkan IHP, perlu diingati bahawa inflasi yang dirasai oleh mana-mana individu mungkin lebih tinggi atau lebih rendah daripada angka ini. Ini tidak bermaksud bahawa angka IHP tidak betul, kerana IHP dirangka sebagai angka purata yang mewakili seluruh penduduk.

publications.en: [Consumer Price Index, Jul 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/cpi_2026-07), the latest edition of the monthly consumer price statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on consumer prices](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/consumer-prices).

OpenDOSM juga memaparkan [papan pemuka khas tentang harga pengguna](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/dashboard/consumer-prices).

Untuk mendapat pemahaman yang lebih mendalam tentang metodologi pemungutan harga dan perangkaan IHP, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/cpi-technotes). Akhirnya, sila ambil maklum bahawa klasifikasi IHP Malaysia dipastikan konsisten dengan United Nations Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP) demi membolehkan perbandingan antarabangsa.

caveats.en: When interpreting inflation rates derived from the CPI, it is important to remember that the rate of inflation experienced by a specific individual may be higher or lower than this number. This does not invalidate the CPI, which is meant to be an average value representative of the entire population.
caveats.ms: Dalam mentafsirkan kadar inflasi yang dihasilkan berdasarkan IHP, perlu diingati bahawa inflasi yang dirasai oleh mana-mana individu mungkin lebih tinggi atau lebih rendah daripada angka ini. Ini tidak bermaksud bahawa angka IHP tidak betul, kerana IHP dirangka sebagai angka purata yang mewakili seluruh penduduk.

description.en: National-level core CPI for 13 main groups of goods and services.
description.ms: IHP teras peringkat nasional bagi 13 kumpulan utama barangan dan perkhidmatan.

methodology.en: The CPI measures the cost of purchasing a constant, representative 'basket' of goods and services. The quantity and quality of goods in the basket are kept constant, so that changes in the cost of the basket are purely due to price changes. The changes in the cost of this basket represent the rate of inflation. The difference between the CPI and core CPI (this dataset) is that core CPI excludes items with volatile prices or government-administered prices. This is usually taken to be a better gauge of the 'underlying' or long-run trend in the price level. For a deeper understanding of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/cpi-technotes). Finally, it should be noted that Malaysia's CPI classification is deliberately consistent with the United Nations Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP) to ensure international comparability.
methodology.ms: IHP mengukur kos pembelian bagi 'bakul' tetap barangan dan perkhidmatan yang mewakili corak purata pembelian penduduk Malaysia. Kualiti dan kuantiti item dalam bakul ini tidak berubah, maka perubahan kos bakul ini disebabkan oleh perubahan harga sahaja. Perubahan kos bakul inilah yang mewakili kadar inflasi. Perbezaan antara IHP dan IHP Teras (set data ini) adalah IHP teras mengecualikan item dengan harga yang tidak menentu atau harga yang dikawal oleh kerajaan. Ini biasanya dianggap sebagai indikator yang lebih tepat bagi tren harga jangka panjang. Untuk mendapat pemahaman yang lebih mendalam tentang metodologi perangkaan IHP, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/cpi-technotes). Akhirnya, sila ambil maklum bahawa klasifikasi IHP Malaysia dipastikan konsisten dengan United Nations Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP) demi membolehkan perbandingan antarabangsa.

caveats.en: The core CPI is not computed for the 'Alcoholic Beverages and Tobacco' category because all items in this category have their prices administered by the government, and are thus excluded from core CPI calculations.
caveats.ms: IHP teras tidak dihasilkan bagi kategori 'Minuman Alkohol dan Tembakau' kerana semua item dalam kategori ini adalah item yang harganya dikawal oleh kerajaan, maka dikecualikan daripada perangkaan IHP teras.

description.en: Number of crimes in Malaysia by district, crime category, and type of crime.
description.ms: Bilangan jenayah di Malaysia mengikut daerah, kategori jenayah, dan jenis jenayah.

methodology.en:
This dataset is tabulated from transactional report-level data collected by the Police Reporting System administered by the Royal Malaysian Police. Most importantly, it shows the number of **actual crimes** (i.e. where a conviction has already occurred) rather than the number of **reported crimes**, which may include false reports. This dataset can also be used in analyses of sexual crime towards women, because all victims of rape as defined by the laws of Malaysia are female (i.e. there is no need to provide a separate dataset with disaggregation by sex).

For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated concepts, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/crime-technotes). Finally, it should be noted that Malaysia's national statistics on crime are compiled in accordance with the International Classification of Crime for Statistical Purpose Version 1.0, which was published by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC), to ensure international comparability.
methodology.ms:
Set data ini dihasilkan daripada rekod transaksi peringkat laporan yang dikumpulkan oleh Sistem Pelaporan Polis yang dikendali oleh Polis Diraja Malaysia. Ia menunjukkan bilangan **jenayah sebenar** (iaitu di mana pesalah telah disabitkan) dan bukannya bilangan **jenayah dilaporkan**, yang termasuk laporan palsu. Selain itu, set data ini juga boleh digunakan dalam sebarang analisis jenayah seks terhaps wanita, kerana semua mangsa rogol seperti yang didefinisikan oleh undang-undang Malaysia adalah wanita (maka tiada keperluan untuk menerbitkan set data lain dengan pecahan mengikut jantina).

Untuk mendapat pemahaman yang lebih mendalam tentang metodologi dan konsep berkaitan, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/crime-technotes). Akhirnya, pihak kerajaan ingin maklumkan bahawa statistik jenayah Malaysia disusun selaras dengan Klasifikasi Jenayah untuk Tujuan Statistik (versi 1.0) yang diterbitkan oleh *United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)*, bagi memudahkan perbandingan dan penarafan antarabangsa.

caveats.en: Unreported crimes are not included in this dataset. In general, it is acknowledged that the true crime rate may exceed the reported crime rate, especially for crimes where there are significant disincentives or barriers to reporting.
caveats.ms: Jenayah yang tidak dilaporkan tidak termasuk dalam set data ini. Secara am, kadar jenayah sebenar mungkin melebihi kadar jenayah dilaporkan, terutamanya bagi jenayah di mana mangsa mengalami kesusahan tertentu dalam membuat laporan secara rasmi.

methodology.en:
Data on crops in Malaysia is collected via establishment-level surveys and censuses conducted by the Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM) in collaboration with the Department of Agriculture (DOA). This data is then used both for the production of agricultural statistics, as well as in the compilation of Malaysia's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data.

For this dataset specifically, the following classifications are helpful to understand (note: paddy, coconut, and flowers are considered self-explanatory):
- **Cash crops** are crops that can provide quick return (within 1 year) to farmers. They include sweet corn, groundnuts, cassava, yam, sweet potato and sugarcane (juice).
- **Industrial crops** are crops grown to manufacture raw industrial materials. They are divided into several groups such as fats (coconut), and groups that produce fresheners (coffee and tea). Industrial crops are grown in large quantities with a relatively long period of planting, ranging from one year to many years.
- **Herbs** refer to shrubs that usually have soft stems and contain plenty of water. This generally means all plants which have value to medicine, food (health and supplements), perfumes, fragrance and cosmetics. 
- **Spices** are aromatic crops used as coloring and flavoring for culinary purposes such as nutmeg and ginger.
- **Fruits and Vegetables** refer specifically to the tropical species grown in Malaysia, which has an equatorial climate. Examples of tropical fruits are banana, mango, papaya, pineapple, durian, rambutan and jackfruit, while examples of tropical vegetables are spinach, okra, eggplant, water spinach, long beans, loofah and bitter gourd.
methodology.ms:
Data dikumpulkan melalui survei dan banci di peringkat perusahaan yang dilaksanakan oleh Jabatan Perangkaan Malaysia (DOSM) dengan kerjasama Jabatan Pertanian (DOA). Data ini kemudian digunakan untuk menghasilkan bukan sahaja statistik rasmi pertanian, tetapi juga statistik Keluaran Dalam Negeri Kasar (KDNK) Malaysia.

Bagi set data ini secara khusus, pengkelasan yang digunakan adalah seperti berikut (nota: padi, kokonut, dan bunga-bunga dianggap tidak perlu didefinisikan selanjutnya):
- **Tanaman kontan** adalah tanaman yang boleh memberikan pulangan cepat (dalam tempoh 1 tahun) kepada petani. Ia termasuk jagung manis, kacang tanah, ubi kayu, keladi, ubi keledek dan tebu (jus).
- **Tanaman industri** adalah tanaman yang ditanam untuk menghasilkan bahan mentah industri. Ia dibahagikan kepada beberapa kumpulan seperti lemak (kelapa), dan kumpulan yang menghasilkan penyegar (kopi dan teh). Tanaman industri ditanam dalam kuantiti yang besar dengan tempoh penanaman yang agak lama, bermula dari satu tahun hingga bertahun-tahun.
- **Herba** merujuk kepada tumbuhan renek yang biasanya mempunyai batang lembut dan mengandungi banyak air. Secara umumnya, ini bermaksud semua tumbuhan yang mempunyai nilai untuk perubatan, makanan (kesihatan dan suplemen), minyak wangi, wangian dan kosmetik.
- **Rempah** adalah tanaman aromatik yang digunakan sebagai pewarna dan perisa untuk tujuan masakan seperti buah pala dan halia.
- **Buah-buahan** dan Sayur-sayuran merujuk khusus kepada spesies tropika yang ditanam di Malaysia, yang mempunyai iklim khatulistiwa. Contoh buah-buahan tropika adalah pisang, mangga, betik, nanas, durian, rambutan dan nangka, manakala contoh sayur-sayuran tropika adalah bayam, bendi, terung, kangkung, kacang panjang, petola dan peria.

caveats.en: Values for breakdowns may be slightly different to totals when summed, due to rounding.
caveats.ms: Angka-angka terperinci mungkin sedikit berbeza dengan angka keseluruhan apabila dijumlahkan, disebabkan oleh penggenapan.

methodology.en: Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) is the sole issuer of currency in Malaysia, and has a duty to ensure a sufficient supply of notes and coins at all times, including during festive seasons when demand for cash is higher than normal. Accordingly, BNM is able to track how much currency is in circulation at any given point in time. That data is summarised in this dataset at monthly frequency.
methodology.ms: Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) adalah satu-satunya penerbit mata wang di Malaysia, dan bertanggungjawab untuk memastikan bekalan nota dan syiling mencukupi pada setiap masa, termasuk semasa musim perayaan apabila permintaan lebih tinggi daripada biasa. Oleh itu, BNM dapat mengesan nilai mata wang dalam edaran pada bila-bila masa. Data tersebut dirumuskan dalam set data ini pada frekuensi bulanan.

caveats.en:
Bank Negara Malaysia commenced the issue of Malaysian currency on 12 June 1967. Accordingly, although not caveats per se, it is helpful to bear the following dates in mind when analysing currency in circulation.

With respect to notes in circulation:
1. The RM500 and RM1,000 banknotes were demonetised on 1 July 1999.
2. The second banknote series of RM1, RM5, RM10, RM20, RM50, RM100, RM500 and RM1,000  was issued from 1982.
3. The third banknote series of RM1, RM2, RM5, RM10, RM50 and RM100 was issued from 1996.
4. The fourth banknote series of RM50 was issued from 2009, with the corresponding fourth series of RM1, RM5, RM10, RM20 and RM100 issued from 16 July 2012.

With respect to coins:
1. The one ringgit coin ceased to be legal tender on 7 December 2005.
2. The second coin series of 1sen, 5sen, 10sen, 20sen, 50sen and RM1 was issued from 1989.
3. The third coin series of 1sen, 5sen, 10sen, 20sen, and 50sen was issued from 16 January 2012.
caveats.ms:
Bank Negara Malaysia mula mengeluarkan mata wang Malaysia pada 12 Jun 1967. Sehubungan itu, terdapat beberapa tarikh penting yang harus diambil kira semasa menganalisa mata wang dalam edaran.

Berkaitan nota dalam edaran:
1. Wang kertas RM500 dan RM1,000 dinyahwangkan pada 1 Julai 1999.
2. Wang kertas siri kedua RM1, RM5, RM10, RM20, RM50, RM100, RM500 dan RM1,000 dikeluarkan mulai tahun 1982.
3. Wang kertas siri ketiga RM1, RM2, RM5, RM10, RM50 and RM100 dikeluarkan mulai tahun 1996.
4. Wang kertas siri keempat RM50 dikeluarkan mulai tahun 2009, manakala siri keempat RM1, RM5, RM10, RM20 dan RM100 dikeluarkan mulai 16 Julai 2012.

Berkaitan syiling dalam edaran:
1. Duit syiling satu ringgit tidak lagi sah diperakukan pada 7 Disember 2005.
2. Duit syiling siri kedua 1sen, 5sen, 10sen, 20sen, 50sen dan RM1 dikeluarkan mulai tahun 1989.
3.Duit syiling siri ketiga 1sen, 5sen, 10sen, 20sen dan 50sen dikeluarkan mulai 16 Januari 2012.

description.en: Annual number of deaths registered with JPN.
description.ms: Jumlah kematian tahunan yang didaftarkan dengan JPN.

methodology.en: The data on deaths in Malaysia is tabulated based on information reported during the deaths registration process, specifically in the in Register of Death Form (JPN.LM02). For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated definition, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).
methodology.ms: Data mengenai kematian di Malaysia dihasilkan berdasarkan maklumat yang dilaporkan semasa proses pendaftaran kelahiran, khususnya dalam Borang Daftar Kematian (JPN.LM02). Untuk memahami metodologi dengan lebih terperinci, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).

caveats.en: This data is derived based on deaths registered with JPN. Therefore, if a death is not registered with JPN (for instance, if the death of a foreigner is registered in their home country, or the death of resident in a remote area is not registered), it will generally not count in this dataset. However, adjustment has been made to the number of deaths in Sabah to account for the under-reporting of deaths detected based on the 'Study of Under Reporting of Deaths in Sabah', which was conducted by DOSM and approved by the Steering Committee on Implementation of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in 2016.
caveats.ms: Data ini dihasilkan berdasarkan kematian yang didaftarkan dengan JPN. Oleh itu, sekiranya kematian itu tidak didaftarkan dengan JPN (contohnya sekiranya kematian rakyat asing hanya didaftarkan di negara asal, ataupun kematian penduduk di kawasan yang sangat terpencil tidak didaftarkan) maka ia secara am tidak terkandung dalam set data ini. Namun, penyesuaian data kematian di Sabah telah dilaksanakan kerana kurang liputan pendaftaran yang didapati berdasarkan 'Kajian Kurang Liputan Pendaftaran Kematian di Sabah' yang telah dijalankan oleh DOSM dan diluluskan oleh Jawatankuasa Induk Pelaksanaan _Civil Registration and Vital Statistics_ pada tahun 2016.

description.en: Annual number and rate of deaths by administrative district and sex.
description.ms: Jumlah dan kadar kematian tahunan mengikut daerah pentadbiran dan jantina.

methodology.en: The data on deaths in Malaysia is tabulated based on information reported during the deaths registration process, specifically in the in Register of Death Form (JPN.LM02). The 'district' reported in this dataset is based on the place of usual residence of the deceased, not the geographical location in which the deceased passed away. For example, a person who passes away at a hospital in Petaling but resided in Sepang will be recorded as a death for Sepang. For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated definition, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).
methodology.ms: Data mengenai kematian di Malaysia dihasilkan berdasarkan maklumat yang dilaporkan semasa proses pendaftaran kelahiran, khususnya dalam Borang Daftar Kematian (JPN.LM02). Medan 'daerah' yang dilaporan dalam set data ini adalah berdasarkan tempat kediaman biasa simati dan bukannya lokasi geografi di mana simati telah meninggal dunia. Sebagai contoh, jika seseorang itu telah meninggal dunia di sebuah hospital di Petaling tetapi telah menetap di Sepang, maka kematian tersebut akan direkodkan sebagai kematian bagi Selangor. Untuk memahami metodologi dengan lebih terperinci, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).

caveats.en:
This data is derived based on deaths registered with JPN. Therefore, if a death is not registered with JPN (for instance, if the death of a foreigner is registered in their home country, or the death of resident in a remote area is not registered), it will generally not count in this dataset. However, adjustment has been made to the number of deaths in Sabah to account for the under-reporting of deaths detected based on the 'Study of Under Reporting of Deaths in Sabah', which was conducted by DOSM and approved by the Steering Committee on Implementation of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in 2016.

Furthermore, it should be noted that the number of administrative districts increased from 147 to 160 in 2021, due to the creation of new districts in Kelantan (1), Perak (1), Sabah (2), and Sarawak (9).
caveats.ms:
Data ini dihasilkan berdasarkan kematian yang didaftarkan dengan JPN. Oleh itu, sekiranya kematian itu tidak didaftarkan dengan JPN (contohnya sekiranya kematian rakyat asing hanya didaftarkan di negara asal, ataupun kematian penduduk di kawasan yang sangat terpencil tidak didaftarkan) maka ia secara am tidak terkandung dalam set data ini. Namun, penyesuaian data kematian di Sabah telah dilaksanakan kerana kurang liputan pendaftaran yang didapati berdasarkan 'Kajian Kurang Liputan Pendaftaran Kematian di Sabah' yang telah dijalankan oleh DOSM dan diluluskan oleh Jawatankuasa Induk Pelaksanaan _Civil Registration and Vital Statistics_ pada tahun 2016.

Tambahan lagi, harus diambil perhatian bahawa bilangan daerah pentadbiran telah bertambah dari 147 ke 160 pada tahun 2021, kerana pengwujudan daerah pentadbiran baru di Kelantan (1), Perak (1), Sabah (2), dan Sarawak (9).

description.en: Annual number of deaths aged less than 5 year old, broken down into perinatal, neonatal, infant and toddler deaths.
description.ms: Jumlah tahunan kematian yang berumur kurang daripada 5 tahun, dengan pecahan kepada kematian perinatal, neonatal, bayi dan kanak-kanak kecil.

methodology.en:
This data is a subset of the data on [deaths](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/deaths), for which the following definitions should be noted:
 - **Toddler Death**: Death of a person aged 1 to 4 years old.
- **Infant Death**: Death of a person less than 1 year old.
 - **Neonatal Death**: Death of a infant aged  less than 28 days old (subset of infant deaths).
 - **Perinatal Death**: Death of an infant less than 7 days old (subset of infant deaths), and [stillbirths](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/stillbirths).

 For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated definitions, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Data ini adalah subset kepada data [kematian](https://data.gov.my/ms-MY/data-catalogue/deaths), di mana definisi berikut perlu diperhatikan:
 - **Kematian Kanak-Kanak Kecil**: Kematian seseorang yang berumur 1 hingga 4 tahun.
- **Kematian Bayi**: Kematian seseorang yang berumur kurang daripada 1 tahun.
 - **Kematian Neonatal**: Kematian bayi yang berumur kurang daripada 28 hari (subset daripada kematian bayi).
 - **Kematian Perinatal**: Kematian bayi yang berumur kurang daripada 7 hari (subset daripada kematian bayi), serta [kelahiran mati](https://data.gov.my/ms-MY/data-catalogue/stillbirths).

 Untuk memahami metodologi dengan lebih terperinci, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).

caveats.en: This data is derived based on deaths registered with JPN. Therefore, if an early childhood death is not registered with JPN (for instance, if the infant death of a foreigner is registered in their home country, or the infant death of citizen in a remote area is not registered), it will generally not count in this dataset. However, adjustment has been made to the number of deaths in Sabah to account for the under-reporting of deaths detected based on the 'Study of Under Reporting of Deaths in Sabah', which was conducted by DOSM and approved by the Steering Committee on Implementation of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in 2016.
caveats.ms: Data ini dihasilkan berdasarkan kematian yang didaftarkan dengan JPN. Oleh itu, sekiranya kematian kanak-kanak kecil itu tidak didaftarkan dengan JPN (contohnya sekiranya kematian bayi bukan warganegara hanya didaftarkan di negara asal, ataupun kematian bayi di kawasan yang sangat terpencil tidak didaftarkan) maka ia secara am tidak terkandung dalam set data ini. Namun, penyesuaian data kematian di Sabah telah dilaksanakan kerana kurang liputan pendaftaran yang didapati berdasarkan 'Kajian Kurang Liputan Pendaftaran Kematian di Sabah' yang telah dijalankan oleh DOSM dan diluluskan oleh Jawatankuasa Induk Pelaksanaan _Civil Registration and Vital Statistics_ pada tahun 2016.

description.en: Annual number of deaths aged less than 5 year old by sex, broken down into neonatal and infant deaths.
description.ms: Jumlah tahunan kematian yang berumur kurang daripada 5 tahun mengikut jantina, dengan pecahan kepada kematian neonatal dan bayi.

methodology.en:
This data is a subset of the data on [deaths](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/deaths), for which the following definitions should be noted:
- **Infant Death**: Death of a person less than 1 year old.
 - **Neonatal Death**: Death of a infant aged  less than 28 days old (subset of infant deaths).

 For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated definitions, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Data ini adalah subset kepada data [kematian](https://data.gov.my/ms-MY/data-catalogue/deaths), di mana definisi berikut perlu diperhatikan:
- **Kematian Bayi**: Kematian seseorang yang berumur kurang daripada 1 tahun.
 - **Kematian Neonatal**: Kematian bayi yang berumur kurang daripada 28 hari (subset daripada kematian bayi).

 Untuk memahami metodologi dengan lebih terperinci, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).

caveats.en: This data is derived based on deaths registered with JPN. Therefore, if an early childhood death is not registered with JPN (for instance, if the death of a foreign infant is registered in their home country, or the death of an infant citizen in a remote area is not registered), it will generally not count in this dataset. However, adjustment has been made to the number of deaths in Sabah to account for the under-reporting of deaths detected based on the 'Study of Under Reporting of Deaths in Sabah', which was conducted by DOSM and approved by the Steering Committee on Implementation of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in 2016.
caveats.ms: Data ini dihasilkan berdasarkan kematian yang didaftarkan dengan JPN. Oleh itu, sekiranya kematian kanak-kanak kecil itu tidak didaftarkan dengan JPN (contohnya sekiranya kematian bayi bukan warganegara hanya didaftarkan di negara asal, ataupun kematian bayi di kawasan yang sangat terpencil tidak didaftarkan) maka ia secara am tidak terkandung dalam set data ini. Namun, penyesuaian data kematian di Sabah telah dilaksanakan kerana kurang liputan pendaftaran yang didapati berdasarkan 'Kajian Kurang Liputan Pendaftaran Kematian di Sabah' yang telah dijalankan oleh DOSM dan diluluskan oleh Jawatankuasa Induk Pelaksanaan _Civil Registration and Vital Statistics_ pada tahun 2016.

publications.en: OpenDOSM features a dashboard on [Population & Vital Statistics](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/population) where you can explore this data in a more interactive manner.
publications.ms: OpenDOSM memaparkan papan pemuka tentang [Penduduk & Perangkaan Penting](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/dashboard/population) yang membolehkan anda menerokai data ini dengan lebih interaktif.

title.en: Annual Early Childhood Deaths by State

description.en: Annual number of deaths aged less than 5 year old by state, broken down into perinatal, neonatal, infant and toddler deaths.
description.ms: Jumlah tahunan kematian yang berumur kurang daripada 5 tahun mengikut negeri, diperincikan ke dalam kematian perinatal, neonatal, bayi dan kanak-kanak kecil.

methodology.en:
This data is a subset of the data on [deaths](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/deaths_state), for which the following definitions should be noted:
 - **Toddler Death**: Death of a person aged 1 to 4 years old.
- **Infant Death**: Death of a person less than 1 year old.
 - **Neonatal Death**: Death of a infant aged  less than 28 days old (subset of infant deaths).
 - **Perinatal Death**: Death of an infant less than 7 days old (subset of infant deaths), and [stillbirths](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/stillbirths).

 For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated definitions, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Data ini adalah subset kepada data [kematian](https://data.gov.my/ms-MY/data-catalogue/deaths_state), di mana definisi berikut perlu diperhatikan:
 - **Kematian Kanak-Kanak Kecil**: Kematian seseorang yang berumur 1 hingga 4 tahun.
- **Kematian Bayi**: Kematian seseorang yang berumur kurang daripada 1 tahun.
 - **Kematian Neonatal**: Kematian bayi yang berumur kurang daripada 28 hari (subset daripada kematian bayi).
 - **Kematian Perinatal**: Kematian bayi yang berumur kurang daripada 7 hari (subset daripada kematian bayi), serta [kelahiran mati](https://data.gov.my/ms-MY/data-catalogue/stillbirths).

 Untuk memahami metodologi dengan lebih terperinci, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).

caveats.en: This data is derived based on deaths registered with JPN. Therefore, if an early childhood death is not registered with JPN (for instance, if the death of a foreign child is registered in their home country, or the death of a citizen in a remote area is not registered), it will generally not count in this dataset. However, adjustment has been made to the number of deaths in Sabah to account for the under-reporting of deaths detected based on the 'Study of Under Reporting of Deaths in Sabah', which was conducted by DOSM and approved by the Steering Committee on Implementation of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in 2016.
caveats.ms: Data ini dihasilkan berdasarkan kematian yang didaftarkan dengan JPN. Oleh itu, sekiranya kematian kanak-kanak kecil itu tidak didaftarkan dengan JPN (contohnya sekiranya kematian bayi bukan warganegara hanya didaftarkan di negara asal, ataupun kematian bayi di kawasan yang sangat terpencil tidak didaftarkan) maka ia secara am tidak terkandung dalam set data ini. Namun, penyesuaian data kematian di Sabah telah dilaksanakan kerana kurang liputan pendaftaran yang didapati berdasarkan 'Kajian Kurang Liputan Pendaftaran Kematian di Sabah' yang telah dijalankan oleh DOSM dan diluluskan oleh Jawatankuasa Induk Pelaksanaan _Civil Registration and Vital Statistics_ pada tahun 2016.

description.en: Annual number of deaths of women during pregnancy or childbirth.
description.ms: Jumlah tahunan kematian wanita semasa mengandung atau melahirkan anak.

methodology.en:
- A maternal death refers to the death of a woman during pregnancy or childbirth, or within 42 days after the termination of pregnancy, irrespective of the duration and site of the pregnancy. Furthermore, the death must have been from a cause related to or aggravated by the pregnancy or its management, not an accidental or unrelated cause.
 - This data is derived based on deaths registered with JPN which have been certified as a maternal death by the Ministry of Health. Data prior to 1963 refers to Peninsular Malaysia only (excluding Singapore). Data from 1963 onwards refers to the entirety of Malaysia (i.e. including Sabah and Sarawak). For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated definition, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).
methodology.ms:
- Kematian ibu bersalin merujuk kepada kematian seorang wanita ketika mengandung atau melahirkan anak, atau dalam tempoh 42 hari selepas melahirkan anak atau keguguran. Tambahan, kematian tersebut mestilah akibat daripada proses kehamilan dan pengendaliannya atau penyakit-penyakit yang menjejaskan kesihatan ibu, dan bukannya daripada kemalangan atau sebab yang tidak berkaitan dengan kehamilan.
 - Data ini dihasilkan berdasarkan kematian yang didaftarkan dengan JPN, yang telah disahkan oleh Kementerian Kesihatan sebagai kematian ibu bersalin. Data sebelum 1963 merujuk kepada Semenanjung Malaysia sahaja (tidak termasuk Singapura). Data dari 1963 dan seterusnya merujuk kepada keseluruhan Malaysia (iaitu termasuk Sabah dan Sarawak). Untuk memahami metodologi dengan lebih terperinci, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).

caveats.en: This data is derived based on deaths registered with JPN. Therefore, if a maternal death is not registered with JPN (for instance, if a foreign maternal death is registered only in their home country, or a maternal death in a remote area is not registered), it will generally not count in this dataset. However, adjustment has been made to the number of deaths in Sabah to account for the under-reporting of deaths detected based on the 'Study of Under Reporting of Deaths in Sabah', which was conducted by DOSM and approved by the Steering Committee on Implementation of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in 2016.
caveats.ms: Data ini dihasilkan berdasarkan kematian yang didaftarkan dengan JPN. Oleh itu, sekiranya kematian ibu bersalin itu tidak didaftarkan dengan JPN (contohnya sekiranya kematian ibu bersalin bukan warganegara hanya didaftarkan di negara asal, ataupun kematian ibu bersalin di kawasan yang sangat terpencil tidak didaftarkan) maka ia secara am tidak terkandung dalam set data ini. Namun, penyesuaian data kematian di Sabah telah dilaksanakan kerana kurang liputan pendaftaran yang didapati berdasarkan 'Kajian Kurang Liputan Pendaftaran Kematian di Sabah' yang telah dijalankan oleh DOSM dan diluluskan oleh Jawatankuasa Induk Pelaksanaan _Civil Registration and Vital Statistics_ pada tahun 2016.

Furthermore, the death must have been from a cause related to or aggravated by the pregnancy or its management, not an accidental or unrelated cause. The 'state' reported in this dataset is based on the place of usual residence of the deceased, not the geographical location in which the deceased passed away. For example, if a woman who resides in Selangor passes away during childbirth at a hospital in Kuala Lumpur, it will be recorded as a maternal death for Selangor. For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated definition, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).

Medan 'negeri' yang dilaporan dalam set data ini adalah berdasarkan tempat kediaman biasa simati dan bukannya lokasi geografi di mana simati telah meninggal dunia. title.en: Annual Deaths by State, Sex, & Ethnicity
title.ms: Kematian Tahunan mengikut Negeri, Jantina & Etnik

description.en: Annual number of deaths, with breakdowns by sex, ethnic group and state.
description.ms: Jumlah kematian tahunan, dengan pecahan mengikut jantina, kumpulan etnik dan negeri.

methodology.en: The data on deaths in Malaysia is tabulated based on information reported during the deaths registration process, specifically in the in Register of Death Form (JPN.LM02). The 'state' reported in this dataset is based on the place of usual residence of the deceased, not the geographical location in which the deceased passed away. For example, a person who passes away at a hospital in Kuala Lumpur but resided in Selangor will be recorded as a death for Selangor. For a deeper understanding of the methodology and associated definition, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).
methodology.ms: Data mengenai kematian di Malaysia dihasilkan berdasarkan maklumat yang dilaporkan semasa proses pendaftaran kelahiran, khususnya dalam Borang Daftar Kematian (JPN.LM02). Medan 'negeri' yang dilaporan dalam set data ini adalah berdasarkan tempat kediaman biasa simati dan bukannya lokasi geografi di mana simati telah meninggal dunia. Sebagai contoh, jika seseorang itu telah meninggal dunia di sebuah hospital di Kuala Lumpur tetapi telah menetap di Selangor, maka kematian tersebut akan direkodkan sebagai kematian bagi Selangor. Untuk memahami metodologi dengan lebih terperinci, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/vitalstats-technotes).

caveats.en: This data is derived based on deaths registered with JPN. Therefore, if a death is not registered with JPN (for instance, if the death of a foreigner is registered in their home country, or the death of resident in a remote area is not registered), it will generally not count in this dataset. However, adjustment has been made to the number of deaths in Sabah to account for the under-reporting of deaths detected based on the 'Study of Under Reporting of Deaths in Sabah', which was conducted by DOSM and approved by the Steering Committee on Implementation of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in 2016.

MYNIC Berhad is the sole official .MY domain registry recognised by the ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers). As such, MYNIC stores transactional records on all .MY domain registrations. As a complement to the [main dataset](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/domains) showing the total number of active .MY domains, this dataset tracks the number of domains which have Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC) enabled, meaning that it utilizes cryptographic signatures to authenticate DNS records and protect against DNS spoofing and poisoning attacks. Tracking this statistic helps gauge the emphasis on cybersecurity among domain owners.

The data is disaggregated into the following domain categories:
- **.my** : For all individuals, companies and organisations from any country

- **.coop.my** : For Malaysian cooperatives registered under the Cooperative Commission of Malaysia
methodology.ms:
MYNIC Berhad adalah satu-satunya pendaftar domain .MY yang disahkan oleh ICANN (_Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers_). Oleh itu, MYNIC menyimpan rekod transaksi bagi semua pendaftaran domain .MY. Sebagai pelengkap kepada [set data utama](https://data.gov.my/data-catalogue/domains) yang menunjukkan bilangan domain .MY yang aktif, set data ini menunjukkan bilangan domain yang menggunakan DNS IPv6 (Protokol Internet versi 6), berbanding IPv4 iaitu versi Protokol Internet pertama yang digunakan secara umum. Statistik ini membantu mengukur penggunaan teknologi internet moden di Malaysia.

Set data ini turut dipecahkan kepada kategori tersebut:
- **.my** : Untuk semua individu, syarikat dan organisasi dari mana-mana negara
- **.com.my** : Untuk organisasi/aktiviti komersial
- **.biz.my** : Untuk organisasi/aktiviti komersial dan PMKS
- **.net.my** : Untuk organisasi/aktiviti berkaitan rangkaian
- **.org.my** : Untuk organisasi/aktiviti lain yang berdaftar di bawah Jabatan Pendaftaran Pertubuhan
- **.edu.my** : Untuk institusi/organisasi pendidikan Malaysia yang berdaftar
- **.gov.my** : Untuk agensi/organisasi kerajaan Malaysia yang rasmi
- **.mil.my** : Untuk agensi/organisasi tentera Malaysia yang rasmi
- **.name.my** : Untuk kegunaan peribadi warganegara Malaysia
- **.coop.my** : Untuk koperasi Malaysia yang berdaftar di bawah Suruhanjaya Koperasi Malaysia

publications.en: This data is fully consistent with the data published on [MYNIC's official statistics page](https://mynic.my/media/statistics).
publications.ms: Data ini selaras dengan data yang diterbitkan di [halaman statistik rasmi MYNIC](https://mynic.my/media/statistics).

title.en: Drug Addicts by State & Age Group
title.ms: Penagih Dadah mengikut Negeri & Kumpulan Umur

description.en: This dataset provides yearly statistics on the number of drug addicts in Malaysia, broken down by state and age group. It offers insights into the demographic distribution of drug addiction across different regions and age categories in the country.
description.ms: Set data ini menyediakan statistik tahunan mengenai bilangan penagih dadah di Malaysia, yang dipecahkan mengikut negeri dan kumpulan umur. Ia menawarkan pandangan tentang taburan demografi penagihan dadah di pelbagai kawasan dan kategori umur di negara ini.

methodology.en: The data is collected annually from national and state-level reports on drug addiction. The age groups are categorized into specific ranges to facilitate a detailed analysis of the demographic distribution of addicts. The dataset includes data from all Malaysian states and territories.
methodology.ms: Data dikumpulkan setiap tahun daripada laporan peringkat kebangsaan dan negeri mengenai penagihan dadah. Kumpulan umur dikategorikan kepada julat tertentu untuk memudahkan analisis terperinci mengenai taburan demografi penagih. Set data ini merangkumi data dari semua negeri dan wilayah di Malaysia.

caveats.en: The dataset may not account for unreported cases of drug addiction. Additionally, the age group labeled 'total' includes all age categories, which might lead to discrepancies if summed with other specific age groups.
caveats.ms: Set data ini mungkin tidak mengambil kira kes penagihan dadah yang tidak dilaporkan. Selain itu, kumpulan umur yang dilabelkan sebagai 'total' merangkumi semua kategori umur, yang mungkin menyebabkan ketidakkonsistenan jika dijumlahkan dengan kumpulan umur tertentu yang lain.

description.en: This dataset provides information on the types of drugs reported by each state in Malaysia, as recorded by the National Anti-Drugs Agency (AADK). The data is categorized based on the type of drug as defined by relevant acts, and includes the number of addicts associated with each drug type per state.
description.ms: Set data ini menyediakan maklumat mengenai jenis-jenis dadah yang dilaporkan oleh setiap negeri di Malaysia, seperti yang direkodkan oleh Agensi Anti Dadah Kebangsaan (AADK). Data dikategorikan berdasarkan jenis dadah seperti yang ditentukan oleh akta berkaitan, dan termasuk bilangan penagih yang dikaitkan dengan setiap jenis dadah mengikut negeri.

methodology.en: The data is collected annually from records maintained by the National Anti-Drugs Agency (AADK). Each entry in the dataset corresponds to a specific state and includes the type of drug and the number of addicts reported for that drug type. The categorization of drugs is based on existing legal definitions and classifications.
methodology.ms: Data dikumpulkan setiap tahun daripada rekod yang diselenggara oleh Agensi Anti Dadah Kebangsaan (AADK). Setiap entri dalam set data ini merujuk kepada negeri tertentu dan termasuk jenis dadah serta bilangan penagih yang dilaporkan untuk jenis dadah tersebut. Pengkategorian dadah adalah berdasarkan definisi dan klasifikasi undang-undang sedia ada.

caveats.en: The data represents annual records and may not reflect real-time changes or updates. Additionally, the number of addicts is reported as recorded and may not account for unreported cases or discrepancies in data collection methods across different states.
caveats.ms: Data ini mewakili rekod tahunan dan mungkin tidak mencerminkan perubahan atau kemas kini masa nyata. Selain itu, bilangan penagih dilaporkan seperti yang direkodkan dan mungkin tidak mengambil kira kes yang tidak dilaporkan atau perbezaan dalam kaedah pengumpulan data di negeri-negeri yang berbeza.

title.en: Drug Addicts by Highest Education Level
title.ms: Penagih Dadah Mengikut Tahap Pendidikan Tertinggi

description.en: The dataset provides information on drug addicts categorized by their highest level of education. The data is collected by the National Anti-Drugs Agency (NADA) through various treatment and rehabilitation centers across Malaysia. It includes yearly data at both national and state levels.
description.ms: Set data ini menyediakan maklumat mengenai penagih dadah yang dikategorikan mengikut tahap pendidikan tertinggi mereka. Data ini dikumpulkan oleh Agensi Anti Dadah Kebangsaan (AADK) melalui pelbagai pusat rawatan dan pemulihan di seluruh Malaysia. Ia merangkumi data tahunan di peringkat kebangsaan dan negeri.

methodology.en: The data is compiled annually by the National Anti-Drugs Agency (NADA) from records at various treatment and rehabilitation centers throughout Malaysia. Each entry in the dataset represents the number of drug addicts identified within a given year, categorized by their highest level of education and the state in which they were recorded.
methodology.ms: Data ini dikumpulkan setiap tahun oleh Agensi Anti Dadah Kebangsaan (AADK) dari rekod di pelbagai pusat rawatan dan pemulihan di seluruh Malaysia. Setiap entri dalam set data ini mewakili bilangan penagih dadah yang dikenal pasti dalam tahun tertentu, dikategorikan mengikut tahap pendidikan tertinggi mereka dan negeri di mana mereka direkodkan.

caveats.en: The dataset is based on administrative records from NADA's treatment centers and may not capture all cases of drug addiction within the community. The education level is self-reported by the individuals and may not be verified. Additionally, the data does not account for individuals who may have relapsed or those who have not sought treatment.
caveats.ms: Set data ini berdasarkan rekod pentadbiran dari pusat rawatan AADK dan mungkin tidak merekodkan semua kes ketagihan dadah dalam komuniti. Tahap pendidikan dilaporkan sendiri oleh individu dan mungkin tidak disahkan. Selain itu, data ini tidak mengambil kira individu dengan rawatan berulang atau mereka yang tidak mendapatkan rawatan.

description.en: This dataset managed by the National Anti-Drugs Agency (NADA) in collaboration with the Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM), provides annual statistics on drug addiction in Malaysia. It presents data at both the national and state levels, offering insights into trends and demographic breakdowns of drug addiction by occupation. This information is crucial for understanding the impact of drug addiction across different occupational sectors and aids in policy-making and intervention strategies.
description.ms: Dataset ini diuruskan oleh Agensi Anti Dadah Kebangsaan (AADK) dengan kerjasama Jabatan Perangkaan Malaysia (DOSM), menyediakan statistik tahunan mengenai ketagihan dadah di Malaysia. Ia memaparkan data di peringkat nasional dan negeri, memberikan pandangan tentang trend dan pecahan demografi ketagihan dadah mengikut pekerjaan. Maklumat ini penting untuk memahami impak ketagihan dadah di pelbagai sektor pekerjaan dan membantu dalam pembuatan dasar dan strategi intervensi.

methodology.en: The data is collected and compiled annually by the National Anti-Drugs Agency (NADA) and the Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM). It includes information on the number of drug addicts categorized by their occupation, covering both national and state levels. The dataset is updated yearly to reflect current trends and demographic shifts in drug addiction across different occupational groups.
methodology.ms: Data dikumpul dan disusun setiap tahun oleh Agensi Anti Dadah Kebangsaan (AADK) dan Jabatan Perangkaan Malaysia (DOSM). Ia merangkumi maklumat mengenai bilangan penagih dadah yang dikategorikan mengikut pekerjaan mereka, meliputi peringkat nasional dan negeri. Dataset ini dikemas kini setiap tahun untuk mencerminkan trend semasa dan perubahan demografi dalam ketagihan dadah di pelbagai kumpulan pekerjaan.

caveats.en: The dataset may contain missing values for certain occupations or states due to data collection limitations. Additionally, the occupation categories are not exhaustive and may not cover all possible job roles. Users should exercise caution when interpreting trends or making comparisons across different regions or years.
caveats.ms: Dataset ini mungkin mengandungi nilai yang hilang untuk pekerjaan atau negeri tertentu disebabkan oleh batasan pengumpulan data. Selain itu, kategori pekerjaan tidak menyeluruh dan mungkin tidak merangkumi semua peranan kerja yang mungkin. Pengguna harus berhati-hati ketika mentafsirkan trend atau membuat perbandingan merentasi pelbagai wilayah atau tahun.

methodology.en: The dataset is compiled annually and includes data on drug-related arrests at the national level. The data is categorized by sex and age group, and the types of arrests include possession, supply, and positive urine tests. Data is collected from law enforcement records and is intended to provide insights into drug-related offenses across different demographics.
methodology.ms: Set data ini dikumpulkan setiap tahun dan merangkumi data mengenai penangkapan berkaitan dadah di peringkat nasional. Data ini dikategorikan mengikut jantina dan kumpulan umur, dan jenis penangkapan termasuk pemilikan, pembekalan, dan ujian air kencing positif. Data dikumpulkan dari rekod penguatkuasaan undang-undang dan bertujuan untuk memberikan pandangan mengenai kesalahan berkaitan dadah di pelbagai demografi.

caveats.en: The dataset represents annual data and may not reflect real-time changes in drug-related arrest patterns. methodology.en: The dataset compiles annual records of drug-related arrests in Malaysia, categorized by sex and ethnicity. The data is collected from law enforcement agencies and reflects arrests made throughout the year. Arrest types include possession, supply, and positive urine tests for drugs. The data is aggregated to provide national-level insights into drug arrest trends.
