Data dikumpulkan daripada agensi penguatkuasaan undang-undang dan mencerminkan penangkapan yang dibuat sepanjang tahun. Jenis penangkapan termasuk pemilikan, pengedaran, dan ujian air kencing positif untuk dadah. Data ini diagregatkan untuk memberikan pandangan mengenai trend penangkapan dadah di peringkat nasional.

caveats.en: The dataset represents aggregated annual data and may not capture all nuances of individual cases. Rounding may cause slight discrepancies in totals. Data accuracy depends on reporting by law enforcement agencies.

description.en: Indices for the purpose of monitoring Malaysia's economic situation on a monthly basis, consisting of leading, lagging, and coincidence indicators.
description.ms: Indeks bagi tujuan memantau kedudukan ekonomi semasa Malaysia. Index ini terdiri daripada indeks pelopor, serentak dan susulan.

methodology.en:
Data for the compilation of Composite and Diffusion Indexes is obtained from the Department of Statistics Malaysia and the following agencies:
 1. Ministry of Housing and Local Government (MHLG)
 2. Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM)
 3. Road Transport Department (RTD)
 4. Malaysian Investment Development Authority (MIDA)
 5. Employees Provident Fund (EPF)
methodology.ms:
Data bagi penyediaan Indeks Komposit dan Indeks Difusi diperoleh daripada Jabatan Perangkaan Malaysia serta agensi berikut
 1. Kementerian Perumahan dan Kerajaan Tempatan (KPKT)
 2. Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM)
 3. Jabatan Pengangkutan Jalan (JPJ)
 4. Lembaga Pembangunan Pelaburan Malaysia (MIDA)
 5. Kumpulan Wang Simpanan Pekerja (KWSP)

caveats.en: The economic indicators are unable to take into account internal or/and external shocks to the economy.
caveats.ms: Sistem penunjuk ekonomi tidak berupaya untuk mengambil kira kejutan pengaruh dalaman atau/dan luaran kepada ekonomi.

methodology.en: This data is produced based on the Labour Force Survey (LFS), which is designed to collect representative data on the labour force at national and state level. Consistency in methodology has been maintained to ensure that the data is comparable over time. Survey findings are a monthly, quarterly and annual basis. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/lfs-technotes).

Metodologi survei ini dipastikan konsisten untuk mendapatkan perbandingan statistik siri masa. Data daripada survei ini diterbitkan secara bulanan, suku tahunan dan tahunan. Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/lfs-technotes).

caveats.en: The proportions may not sum to 100% due to rounding.

description.en: Annual dividend rates declared by the EPF for conventional and Shariah-compliant investments.
description.ms: Kadar dividen tahunan yang diisytiharkan oleh EPF bagi pelaburan konvensional serta patuh Syariah.

methodology.en: Under the Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Act 1991, the EPF is required to declare a minimum dividend of 2.5% for conventional investments; there is no specified minimum for Shariah-compliant investments. This dataset tabulates the actual dividend rates [declared by the EPF](https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/others/resource-centre/dividend) for both conventional and Shariah-compliant investments.
methodology.ms: Selaras dengan Akta Kumpulan Wang Simpanan Pekerja (EPF) 1991, KWSP diwajibkan mengisytiharkan kadar dividen minimum sebanyak 2.5% untuk pelaburan konvensional, manakala tidak ada kadar minimum yang ditetapkan untuk pelaburan patuh Syariah. Set data ini memaparkan kadar dividen sebenar [yang diisytiharkan oleh KWSP](https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/others/resource-centre/dividend) untuk kedua-dua pelaburan konvensional dan patuh Syariah.

caveats.en: The EPF's Simpanan Shariah was [launched in January 2017](https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/w/registration-for-simpanan-shariah-opens-today) in response to high demand from EPF members during the Members' Consultation exercise. Consequently, the series for Shariah-compliant investments begins in 2017.
caveats.ms: Simpanan Shariah KWSP [dilancarkan pada Januari 2017](https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/w/registration-for-simpanan-shariah-opens-today) susulan permintaan tinggi daripada ahli KWSP semasa Rundingan Awam. Oleh itu, siri untuk pelaburan patuh Syariah bermula pada 2017.

description.en: Monthly rates of exchange of the Malaysian ringgit vis-à-vis selected currencies.
description.ms: Kadar pertukaran ringgit Malaysia berbanding mata wang asing terpilih.

methodology.en:
The Malaysian ringgit (MYR) is a non-internationalised currency, meaning it can only be traded and settled within Malaysia under the regulation of Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM). To combat speculation, offshore trading of the ringgit is not permitted, and any foreign market activity — such as non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) — is purely indicative and settled in foreign currencies rather than MYR.

Consequently, BNM has full oversight over trading over the ringgit, and compiles official exchange rate data based on buy and sell quotations at set times on all trading days:
- 0900: Reference rate for start of day
- 1130: Best counter rates offered by selected commercial banks
- 1200: Reference rate for mid-day
- 1700: Reference rate for end of day

This monthly dataset, which is provided for analytical purposes, is derived using middle rates at 1200.
methodology.ms:
Ringgit Malaysia (MYR) adalah mata wang bukan antarabangsa. Ini bermaksud ia hanya boleh diperdagangkan di Malaysia di bawah pengawalseliaan Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM). Untuk membanteras spekulasi, perdagangan ringgit secara _offshore_ tidak dibenarkan, maka segala aktiviti perdagangan di pasaran asing — seperti _non-deliverable forwards (NDFs)_ — hanya bersifat indikatif dan diselesaikan dalam mata wang asing, bukan MYR.

Akibatnya, BNM mempunyai pengawasan menyeluruh terhadap perdagangan ringgit, dan menerbitkan data kadar pertukaran rasmi berdasarkan harga beli dan jual pada masa tertentu pada semua hari perdagangan:
- 0900: Kadar rujukan untuk permulaan hari
- 1130: Kadar terbaik yang ditawarkan oleh bank komersial yang dipilih
- 1200: Kadar rujukan untuk pertengahan hari
- 1700: Kadar rujukan untuk akhir hari

Set data bulanan ini, yang disediakan untuk tujuan analisis, dihasilkan berdasarkan kadar pertengahan (_middle rate_) pada 1200.

Ringgit digunakan sebagai pengangka, maka nilai yang lebih tinggi menunjukkan penyusutan sementara nilai yang lebih rendah menunjukkan peningkatan.

To combat speculation, offshore trading of the ringgit is not permitted, and any foreign market activity — such as non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) — is purely indicative and settled in foreign currencies rather than MYR.

description.en: Inflows, outflows, and net flows of foreign direct investment (FDI) into Malaysia.
description.ms: Aliran masuk, aliran keluar, dan aliran bersih pelaburan langsung asing (FDI) ke Malaysia.

methodology.en: FDI into Malaysia is a category of investment by non-residents that reflects the objective of obtaining a lasting interest in Malaysia. Financial instruments covered under direct investment include equity, reinvestment of earnings and debt instruments (such as inter-company loans and advances, trade credits). FDI statistics for Malaysia are compiled as part of the balance of payments, which is compiled based on the IMF's BPM6 guidelines. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/bop-technotes), particularly the definitions relating to FDI.
methodology.ms: FDI ke Malaysia adalah kategori pelaburan oleh bukan penduduk yang mencerminkan objektif untuk mendapatkan kepentingan yang berterusan di Malaysia. Instrumen kewangan yang diliputi di bawah pelaburan langsung termasuklah ekuiti, perolehan dilabur semula dan instrumen hutang (seperti pinjaman dan pendahuluan antara syarikat, kredit perdagangan). Statistik FDI bagi Malaysia dikumpulkan sebagai sebahagian daripada imbangan pembayaran, yang dirangka berdasarkan garis panduan BPM6 IMF. Untuk penerangan penuh mengenai metodologi, sila rujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/bop-technotes), terutamanya definisi yang berkaitan dengan FDI.

description.en: Quarterly revenue, operating and development expenditure, overall surplus/deficit, and sources of financing for the Federal Government of Malaysia.
description.ms: Hasil, perbelanjaan mengurus dan pembangunan, lebihan/kurangan keseluruhan, serta sumber kewangan secara suku tahunan bagi Kerajaan Persekutuan Malaysia.

methodology.en:
This data is produced by the Accountant-General's Department in compliance with the [Malaysian Public Sector Accounting Standards](https://www2.anm.gov.my/akruan/Pages/MPSAS.aspx) and the IMF's Dissemination Standards. A few key relationships should be noted:
- Net development expenditure is gross development expenditure less loan recoveries.
- Net borrowing is gross borrowing less repayments, for both the domestic and foreign sectors.
- The overall balance is revenue less operating expenditure less net development expenditure.
- For stock values (such as use of assets), a positive value indicates the disposal of assets while a negative value indicates the acquisition of assets.
methodology.ms:
Data ini dihasilkan oleh Jabatan Akauntan Negara berdasarkan [Piawaian Perakaunan Sektor Awam Malaysia](https://www2.anm.gov.my/akruan/Pages/MPSAS.aspx) dan _IMF Dissemination Standards_. Beberapa hubungan penting perlu diambil perhatian:
- Perbelanjaan pembangunan bersih adalah perbelanjaan pembangunan kasar tolak terimaan balik pinjaman.
- Pinjaman bersih adalah pinjaman kasar tolak pembayaran balik, untuk kedua-dua sektor dalam negeri dan luar negeri.
- Imbangan keseluruhan adalah hasil tolak perbelanjaan mengurus tolak perbelanjaan pembangunan bersih.
- Untuk nilai stok (seperti penggunaan aset), nilai positif mewakili pelupusan aset manakala nilai negatif mewakili penimbuhan aset.

caveats.en: Numbers may not add up due to rounding during derivation. Furthermore, data for 2023 are preliminary and are subject to revision in future releases.
caveats.ms: Jumlah tidak semestinya tepat kerana penggenapan. Tambahan, data bagi 2023 adalah data awalan dan mungkin disemak dalam kemaskini akan datang.

description.en: Quarterly Federal Government revenue from direct taxes, indirect taxes, non-tax sources, as well as non-revenue receipts.
description.ms: Hasil suku tahunan Kerajaan Persekutuan daripada cukai langsung, cukai tidak langsung, sumber bukan cukai, serta terimaan bukan hasil.

methodology.en:
This data is produced by the Accountant-General's Department in compliance with the [Malaysian Public Sector Accounting Standards](https://www2.anm.gov.my/akruan/Pages/MPSAS.aspx) and the IMF's Dissemination Standards. A few definitional nuances should be noted:
- Individual income taxes include collection of income taxes without codes which will eventually be appropriately classified.
- Prior to 2007, the value for other direct taxes includes revenue from the real property gains tax.
- Collection of revenue under the goods and services tax began on 1 April 2015.
- Effective 1 January 2000, the values for indirect sales tax includes revenue from the sales tax on petroleum and petroleum products, which replaced the import and excise duties on these products.
- Other indirect taxes include betting, sweepstakes and gaming taxes, as well as collection of revenue without codes which will eventually be appropriately classified.
- The value for non-tax interest and returns on investment includes profits from PETRONAS and Bank Negara Malaysia.
- The value for other non-tax revenue includes services fees, fines, and penalties.
methodology.ms:
Data ini dihasilkan oleh Jabatan Akauntan Negara berdasarkan [Piawaian Perakaunan Sektor Awam Malaysia](https://www2.anm.gov.my/akruan/Pages/MPSAS.aspx) dan _IMF Dissemination Standards_. Beberapa nuansa dalam definisi pembolehubah perlu diberi perhatian:
- Cukai pendapatan individu termasuk kutipan cukai pendapatan tanpa kod yang akan diklasifikasikan semula nanti.
- Sebelum tahun 2007, nilai untuk cukai langsung lain termasuk hasil daripada cukai atas keuntungan hartanah.
- Kutipan hasil di bawah cukai barangan dan perkhidmatan bermula pada 1 April 2015.
- Berkuatkuasa 1 Januari 2000, nilai untuk cukai jualan tidak langsung termasuk hasil daripada cukai jualan ke atas petroleum dan produk petroleum, yang menggantikan duti import dan eksais ke atas produk ini.
- Cukai tidak langsung lain termasuk cukai bertaruh, judi lumba kuda, dan cukai perjudian, serta kutipan hasil tanpa kod yang akan diklasifikasikan semula nanti.
- Nilai untuk faedah bukan cukai dan pulangan ke atas pelaburan termasuk keuntungan daripada PETRONAS dan Bank Negara Malaysia.
- Nilai untuk hasil bukan cukai lain termasuk bayaran perkhidmatan, denda dan penalti.

caveats.en: Numbers may not add up due to rounding during derivation. Furthermore, data for 2023 are preliminary and are subject to revision in future releases.
caveats.ms: Jumlah tidak semestinya tepat kerana penggenapan. Tambahan, data bagi 2023 adalah data awalan dan mungkin disemak dalam kemaskini akan datang.

description.en: Annual revenue, operating and development expenditure, overall surplus/deficit, and sources of financing for the Federal Government of Malaysia.
description.ms: Hasil, perbelanjaan mengurus dan pembangunan, lebihan/kurangan keseluruhan, serta sumber kewangan secara tahunan bagi Kerajaan Persekutuan Malaysia.

methodology.en:
This data is produced by the Accountant-General's Department in compliance with the [Malaysian Public Sector Accounting Standards](https://www2.anm.gov.my/akruan/Pages/MPSAS.aspx) and the IMF's Dissemination Standards. A few key relationships should be noted:
- Net development expenditure is gross development expenditure less loan recoveries.
- Net borrowing is gross borrowing less repayments, for both the domestic and foreign sectors.
- The overall balance is revenue less operating expenditure less net development expenditure.
- For stock values (such as use of assets), a positive value indicates the disposal of assets while a negative value indicates the acquisition of assets.
methodology.ms:
Data ini dihasilkan oleh Jabatan Akauntan Negara berdasarkan [Piawaian Perakaunan Sektor Awam Malaysia](https://www2.anm.gov.my/akruan/Pages/MPSAS.aspx) dan _IMF Dissemination Standards_. Beberapa hubungan penting perlu diambil perhatian:
- Perbelanjaan pembangunan bersih adalah perbelanjaan pembangunan kasar tolak terimaan balik pinjaman.
- Pinjaman bersih adalah pinjaman kasar tolak pembayaran balik, untuk kedua-dua sektor dalam negeri dan luar negeri.
- Imbangan keseluruhan adalah hasil tolak perbelanjaan mengurus tolak perbelanjaan pembangunan bersih.
- Untuk nilai stok (seperti penggunaan aset), nilai positif mewakili pelupusan aset manakala nilai negatif mewakili penimbuhan aset.

description.en: Total fertility rate (TFR) and age-specific fertility rates (ASFR) from 1958 to the present at national level.
description.ms: Kadar kesuburan keseluruhan (TFR) dan kadar kesuburan mengikut umur (ASFR) dari 1958 hingga kini di peringkat nasional.

methodology.en:
An age-specific fertility rate (ASFR) is the average number of births per 1,000 women in a specific age group. The ASFRs shown in this dataset are computed from administrative records of births registered with JPN (which record the age of the mother), as well as population data from DOSM as the denominator.

The total fertility rate (TFR)  is the average number of children born to a woman who goes through her child-bearing years experiencing the ASFR of each age group. It is computed by:
 - Summing the ASFRs of all age groups, then
 - Multiplying the number by 5 to account for the size of each age group, and finally
 - Dividing by 1000 (to convert the figure from per 1000 women to per woman.
methodology.ms:
Kadar kesuburan mengikut umur (ASFR) adalah purata jumlah kelahiran per 1,000 wanita dalam kumpulan umur tertentu. ASFR yang dipaparkan dalam set data ini dihitung berdasarkan rekod pentadbiran kelahiran yang didaftarkan dengan JPN (yang mencatatkan umur ibu), serta data penduduk dari DOSM.

Kadar kesuburan keseluruhan (TFR) adalah purata jumlah anak yang dilahirkan kepada seorang wanita yang melalui hidupnya dengan mengalami ASFR setiap kumpulan umur. Ia dihitung dengan:
 - Menjumlahkan ASFR semua kumpulan umur, kemudian
 - Mengalikan jumlah dengan 5 untuk mengambil kira julat setiap kumpulan umur, dan akhirnya
 - Membahagikan dengan 1000 untuk mengubah angka dari angka bagi setiap 1000 wanita kepada angka bagi seorang wanita.

caveats.en: ASFR values are based on the actual number of live births per 1000 women in each 5-year age group. However, when interpreting TFR values, it is important to note that the TFR is based on a hypothetical woman who goes through her child-bearing years experiencing the ASFR of each age group. This is not equivalent to the actual average number of children born to currently-living female citizens aged 15-49, as this number would be a reflection of past rather than current ASFR values.
caveats.ms: Nilai ASFR berdasarkan jumlah kelahiran hidup sebenar bagi setiap 1000 wanita dalam setiap kumpulan umur 5 tahun. Walau bagaimanapun, dalam mentafsirkan nilai TFR, perlu diingati bahawa TFR berdasarkan unjuran seorang wanita yang melalui hidupnya dengan mengalami ASFR setiap kumpulan umur. Ini tidak sama dengan purata sebenar jumlah anak yang dilahirkan kepada penduduk wanita berumur 15-49 tahun, kerana angka tersebut sebenarnya dipengaruhi oleh nilai ASFR masa lalu dan bukannya nilai ASFR semasa.

 - Summing the ASFRs of all age groups, then
 - Multiplying the number by 5 to account for the size of each age group, and finally
 - Dividing by 1000 (to convert the figure from per 1000 women to per woman.
methodology.ms:
Kadar kesuburan mengikut umur (ASFR) adalah purata jumlah kelahiran per 1,000 wanita dalam kumpulan umur tertentu. ASFR yang dipaparkan dalam set data ini dihitung berdasarkan rekod pentadbiran kelahiran yang didaftarkan dengan JPN (yang mencatatkan umur ibu), serta data penduduk dari DOSM sebagai denominator.

Kadar kesuburan keseluruhan (TFR) adalah purata jumlah anak yang dilahirkan kepada seorang wanita yang melalui hidupnya dengan mengalami ASFR setiap kumpulan umur. Ia dihitung dengan:
 - Menjumlahkan ASFR semua kumpulan umur, kemudian
 - Mengalikan jumlah dengan 5 untuk mengambil kira julat setiap kumpulan umur, dan akhirnya
 - Membahagikan dengan 1000 untuk mengubah angka dari angka bagi setiap 1000 wanita kepada angka bagi seorang wanita.

caveats.en: ASFR values are based on the actual number of live births per 1000 women in each 5-year age group. However, when interpreting TFR values, it is important to note that the TFR is based on a hypothetical woman who goes through her child-bearing years experiencing the ASFR of each age group. This is not equivalent to the actual average number of children born to currently-living female citizens aged 15-49, as this number would be a reflection of past rather than current ASFR values.
caveats.ms: Nilai ASFR berdasarkan jumlah kelahiran hidup sebenar bagi setiap 1000 wanita dalam setiap kumpulan umur 5 tahun. Walau bagaimanapun, dalam mentafsirkan nilai TFR, perlu diingati bahawa TFR berdasarkan unjuran seorang wanita yang melalui hidupnya dengan mengalami ASFR setiap kumpulan umur. Ini tidak sama dengan purata sebenar jumlah anak yang dilahirkan kepada penduduk wanita berumur 15-49 tahun, kerana angka tersebut sebenarnya dipengaruhi oleh nilai ASFR masa lalu dan bukannya nilai ASFR semasa.

title.en: Monthly Landings of Marine Fish by State
title.ms: Pendaratan Ikan Laut Bulanan mengikut Negeri

description.en: Monthly landings of marine fish by state and coast from 2018 to 2023.
description.ms: Pendaratan ikan laut bulanan mengikut negeri dan pantai dari 2018 hingga 2023.

methodology.en:
Data on landings of marine fish in Malaysia is collected via establishment-level surveys and censuses conducted by the Department of Fisheries (DOF). Accordingly, this data reflects the production of establishments registered with the DOF only. In layperson terms, this means that the fish caught by individuals fishing for personal consumption are not included in this data.

It should be noted that W.P. Kuala Lumpur and W.P. Putrajaya are excluded from the data as they do not have coastlines. Classification by coast and state is conducted based on the location of where the fish was landed, not where it was caught or the registered address of the establishment. In general, fisheries data for Malaysia is published based on landings, not catches.
methodology.ms:
Data pendaratan ikan laut di Malaysia dikumpulkan melalui survei dan banci perusahaan perikanan yang dilaksanakan oleh Jabatan Perikanan. Oleh itu, data ini merujuk kepada data syarikat yang berdaftar dengan Jabatan Perikanan sahaja. Dalam bahasa mudah, ini bermaksud bahawa ikan yang ditangkap oleh individu untuk tujuan peribadi tidak termasuk dalam data ini.

W.P. Kuala Lumpur dan W.P. Putrajaya tidak terkandung dalam set data ini kerana tiada pantai di negeri tersebut. Tambahan lagi, pengkelasan berdasarkan pantai dan negeri adalah berdasarkan lokasi pendaratan iakn, bukan lokasi tangkapan atau alamat berdaftar syarikat. Secara am, data perikanan di Malaysia diterbitkan berdasarkan pendaratan, bukan tangkapan.

caveats.en: National totals may be slightly different to the sum of state values due to rounding.
caveats.ms: Angka-angka di peringkat nasional mungkin sedikit berbeza dengan angka peringkat negeri apabila dijumlahkan disebabkan oleh penggenapan.

description.en: The area of permanent forest reserves as of year-end.
description.ms: Keluasan tahunan hutan simpan setakat hujung tahun.

methodology.en: Permanent Reserved Forests (PRFs) are government lands that have been gazetted under the National Forestry Act 1984. Under the National Forestry Policy 1978 (Amendment 1992), PRFs must be managed and classified under four main functions: protection, production, recreation, and research. This dataset records the area of land gazetted as PRFs in Malaysia, with the area is calculated directly from the gazetted PRF maps. For a richer understanding of the definition and purposes of PRFs, please refer to [this policy document](https://storage.data.gov.my/environment/hsk_2021-04-29.pdf).
methodology.ms: Hutan Simpan Kekal (HSK) ialah kawasan-kawasan tanah kerajaan yang telah diwartakan di bawah Akta Perhutanan Negara 1984. Di bawah Dasar Perhutanan Negara 1978 (Pindaan 1992), HSK perlu diurus dan dikelaskan di bawah empat fungsi utama iaitu hutan perlindungan, hutan berhasil, hutan lipur dan hutan penyelidikan. Set data ini merekodkan keluasan kawasan yang diwartakan sebagai HSK di Malaysia, di mana keluasan tersebut dikira secara terus daripada peta HSK yang diwartakan. Untuk mendapat pemahaman yang lebih mendalam mengenai definisi dan tujuan HSK, sila rujuk kepada [dokumen dasar ini](https://storage.data.gov.my/environment/hsk_2021-04-29.pdf)

caveats.en: Data prior to 2017 includes the area of included proposed PRFs in Peninsular Malaysia which had not yet been gazetted. Data from 2017 is based only on the area of gazetted PRFs. Furthermore, data for 2010 and 2011 is not available at present and will be updated at a later date.
caveats.ms: Data sebelum 2017 termasuk cadangan HSK di Semenanjung Malaysia yang belum diwartakan. Mulai 2017, data adalah berdasarkan keluasan HSK yang diwartakan sahaja. Tambahan lagi, data bagi tahun 2010 dan 2011 tidak tersedia buat masa ini, dan akan dikemaskini nanti.

description.en: Weekly retail prices of RON95 petrol, RON97 petrol, and diesel in Malaysia.
description.ms: Harga runcit mingguan bagi petrol RON95, petrol RON97 dan diesel di Malaysia.

methodology.en: This dataset presents the weekly retail price of RON95 petrol, RON97 petrol, and diesel in Malaysia. Since April 2017, the retail price of fuel in Malaysia has been set on a weekly basis (except for a short period at the end of 2018 where it was announced monthly) using the Automatic Pricing Mechanism (APM). The APM is designed to allow the government to monitor the effects of changes in global crude oil prices and adjust retail fuel prices to ensure the continued welfare of the rakyat.
methodology.ms: Data ini memaparkan harga runcit mingguan bagi petrol RON95, petrol RON97 dan diesel di Malaysia. Sejak April 2017, harga runcit petrol di Malaysia telah ditetapkan pada kadar mingguan (kecuali setempoh di hujung tahun 2018 ketika harga diumumkan secara bulanan) dengan menggunakan formula Mekanisme Harga Automatik (APM). Formula APM dikhususkan untuk memboleh kerajaan memantau kesan perubahan harga minyak mentah global dan mengambil langkah bersesuaian bagi memastikan kebajikan rakyat terus terpelihara.

caveats.en:
The following information should be incorporated into any analysis of fuel prices in Malaysia:

- Malaysia's goods and services tax (GST) was zero-rated on 1 June 2018, with the sales and services tax (SST) subsequently implemented on 1 September 2018. However, because petrol and diesel prices are controlled by the government, they were not affected by this.
- Beginning 3 March 2021, the announcement of fuel prices was changed from Fridays to Wednesdays.
- On 10 June 2024, diesel subsidies were removed in Peninsular Malaysia, leading to a discontinuous jump from RM2.15 to RM3.35 per litre. Therefore, beginning 13 June 2024, the weekly price of diesel was announced separately for Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia (Sarawak, Sabah, W.P. Labuan).
- On 30 Sep 2025, the price of RON95 petrol was increased to RM2.60 for the general market, lowered to RM1.99 (up to a maximum of 300 litres per month) for eligibles individuals under the BUDI 95 subsidy, and maintained at RM2.05 for commercial vehicles eligible under the Subsidised Petrol Control System (SPCS).
caveats.ms:
Maklumat tersebut harus diambil kira dalam mana-mana analisis harga bahan api di Malaysia:

- Kadar cukai perkhidmatan dan barangan (GST) di Malaysia disifarkan pada 1 Jun 2018, dengan pelaksanaan cukai jualan dan perkhidmatan (SST) berkuatkuasa pada 1 September 2018. Namun, oleh kerana harga petrol dan diesel di Malaysia dikawal oleh kerajaan, maka harganya tidak terkesan oleh pertukaran tersebut.
- Bermula 3 Mac 2021, pengumuman harga petrol dan diesel diubah dari hari Jumaat ke hari Rabu.
- Pada 10 Jun 2024, subsidi diesel dimansuhkan di Semenanjung Malaysia, menyebabkan harga diesel meningkat dari RM2.15 ke RM3.35 seliter. Oleh itu, bermula 13 Jun 2024, pengumuman mingguan harga diesel dibuat secara berasingan bagi Semenanjung Malaysia dan Malaysia Timur (Sarawak, Sabah, W.P. Labuan).
- Pada 30 Sep 2025, harga petrol RON95 dinaikkan kepada RM2.60 bagi pasaran umum, diturunkan kepada RM1.99 (dengan had 300 liter sebulan) bagi individu yang layak di bawah subsidi BUDI 95, dan dikekalkan pada RM2.05 bagi kenderaan komersial yang layak di bawah Sistem Kawalan Petrol Bersubsidi (SKPS).

title.en: Annual Nominal GDP by Expenditure Type
title.ms: KDNK Nominal Tahunan mengikut Jenis Perbelanjaan

description.en: Annual gross domestic product (GDP) at current prices, by expenditure type.
description.ms: Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) tahunan pada harga semasa, mengikut jenis perbelanjaan.

methodology.en:
Gross domestic product (GDP) is the total value of goods and services produced within that year, after deducting the cost of goods and services used in production, but before deducting the consumption of fixed capital. In Malaysia, GDP is estimated in compliance with the [System of National Accounts (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

In general, GDP can be measured via 3 approaches, namely production, expenditure, and income. Because the measurement employs double entry accounting, the overall value must be the same across all 3 approaches. However, the different approaches allow GDP to be analysed in different ways. The GDP estimates in this dataset were produced using the expenditure method (C + I + G + X - M), which allows insight into who is buying the output of the Malaysian economy; households, businesses, government, or other countries. The values were measured at current prices, i.e. without removing price effects. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) adalah jumlah nilai barangan dan perkhidmatan yang dihasilkan dalam tahun tersebut, selepas ditolak kos barangan dan perkhidmatan yang digunakan dalam proses pengeluaran, tetapi sebelum ditolak penggunaan modal tetap. Di Malaysia, anggaran KDNK dihasilkan selaras dengan [Sistem Akaun Nasional (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

Secara am, KDNK boleh diukur melalui 3 kaedah, iaitu pengeluaran, perbelanjaan, dan pendapatan. Memandangkan bahawa pengukurannya menggunakan sistem perakaunan catatan bergu, angka keseluruhan mesti sama bagi ketiga-tiga kaedah tersebut. Namun, kaedah yang berbeza itu membolehkan analisis KDNK yang berlainan. Anggaran KDNK dalam set data ini dihasilkan melalui kaedah perbelanjaan (C + I + G + X - M), yang membolehkan analisis tentang siapa yang membeli pengeluaran ekonomi Malaysia; sama ada isi rumah, perniagaan, kerajaan, atau negara lain. Angka-angka diukur pada harga semasa, iaitu tidak mengeluarkan kesan harga. Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).

caveats.en: Values for 2024 and 2025 may be revised in future releases. Furthermore, the sum of GDP for all expenditure types may not always equal to the values for overall GDP because of independent rounding to one decimal place. However, the differences are not obvious.
caveats.ms: Angka bagi 2024 dan 2025 mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan akan datang. Tambahan, hasil tambah nilai KDNK bagi semua jenis perbelanjaan mungkin tidak sentiasa sama dengan nilai KDNK keseluruhan kerana pembundaran secara bebas. Walau bagaimanapun, perbezaan ini tidak ketara.

publications.en: [Gross Domestic Product, 2025](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/gdp_2025), the latest edition of the annual GDP statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on GDP](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/gdp) which enables you to explore Malaysia's GDP data interactively.

title.en: Annual Real GDP by Expenditure Subtype
title.ms: KDNK Sebenar Tahunan mengikut Subjenis Perbelanjaan

description.en: Annual gross domestic product (GDP) at constant 2015 prices, by expenditure type and subtype. The table provides a preview of the full dataset using the latest year's data only.
description.ms: Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) tahunan pada harga malar 2015, mengikut jenis dan subjenis perbelanjaan. Jadual memberi pratonton kepada set data penuh dengan menggunakan data tahun terkini sahaja.

methodology.en:
Gross domestic product (GDP) is the total value of goods and services produced within that year, after deducting the cost of goods and services used in production, but before deducting the consumption of fixed capital. In Malaysia, GDP is estimated in compliance with the [System of National Accounts (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

In general, GDP can be measured via 3 approaches, namely production, expenditure, and income. Because the measurement employs double entry accounting, the overall value must be the same across all 3 approaches. However, the different approaches allow GDP to be analysed in different ways. The GDP estimates in this dataset were produced using the expenditure method (C + I + G + X - M), which allows insight into who is buying the output of the Malaysian economy; households, businesses, government, or other countries. The values were measured at constant 2015 prices, i.e. with price effects removed relative to a base year (2015 = 100). For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) adalah jumlah nilai barangan dan perkhidmatan yang dihasilkan dalam tahun tersebut, selepas ditolak kos barangan dan perkhidmatan yang digunakan dalam proses pengeluaran, tetapi sebelum ditolak penggunaan modal tetap. Di Malaysia, anggaran KDNK dihasilkan selaras dengan [Sistem Akaun Nasional (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

Secara am, KDNK boleh diukur melalui 3 kaedah, iaitu pengeluaran, perbelanjaan, dan pendapatan. Memandangkan bahawa pengukurannya menggunakan sistem perakaunan catatan bergu, angka keseluruhan mesti sama bagi ketiga-tiga kaedah tersebut. Namun, kaedah yang berbeza itu membolehkan analisis KDNK yang berlainan. Anggaran KDNK dalam set data ini dihasilkan melalui kaedah perbelanjaan (C + I + G + X - M), yang membolehkan analisis tentang siapa yang membeli pengeluaran ekonomi Malaysia; sama ada isi rumah, perniagaan, kerajaan, atau negara lain. Angka-angka diukur pada harga malar 2015, iaitu dengan mengeluarkan kesan harga berbanding tahun asas (2015 = 100). Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).

caveats.en: Values for 2024 and 2025 may be revised in future releases. Furthermore, the sum of GDP for all expenditure types may not always equal to the values for overall GDP because of independent rounding to one decimal place. However, the differences are not obvious.
caveats.ms: Angka bagi 2024 dan 2025 mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan akan datang. Tambahan, hasil tambah nilai KDNK bagi semua jenis perbelanjaan mungkin tidak sentiasa sama dengan nilai KDNK keseluruhan kerana pembundaran secara bebas. Walau bagaimanapun, perbezaan ini tidak ketara.

publications.en: [Gross Domestic Product, 2025](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/gdp_2025), the latest edition of the annual GDP statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on GDP](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/gdp) which enables you to explore Malaysia's GDP data interactively.

description.en: Annual district-level gross domestic product (GDP) at constant 2015 prices for the 5 main economic sectors.
description.ms: Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) tahunan peringkat daerah pada harga malar 2015 bagi 5 sektor ekonomi utama.

methodology.en:
Gross domestic product (GDP) is the total value of goods and services produced within that year, after deducting the cost of goods and services used in production, but before deducting the consumption of fixed capital. caveats.en:
There are several caveats to note:
- Values for W.P. Putrajaya are subsumed under values for W.P. Kuala Lumpur due to difficulty in separating the attribution of economic value.
- Sectoral values of less than RM 5 million are intentionally nulled; these are different from values which are explicitly enumerated as 0.
- The sum of GDP for all sectors may not always equal to the values for overall GDP because of independent rounding to one decimal place. However, the differences are not obvious.
caveats.ms:
Terdapat beberapa perkara yang perlu diberi perhatian:
- Nilai bagi W.P. Putrajaya dimasukkan bawah nilai W.P. Kuala Lumpur kerana kesukaran dalam membezakan punca nilai ekonomi.
- Nilai sektor yang kurang daripada RM 5 juta sengaja dijadikan null. Ini tidak sama dengan angka yang diperincikan sebagai 0.
- Hasil tambah nilai KDNK bagi semua sektor mungkin tidak sentiasa sama dengan nilai KDNK keseluruhan kerana pembundaran secara bebas. Walau bagaimanapun, perbezaan ini tidak ketara.

title.en: Annual Nominal GDP & GNI: 1947 to Present
title.ms: KDNK & PNK Sebenar Tahunan: 1947 sehingga Kini

description.en: Long time series of annual nominal gross domestic product (GDP) and gross national income (GNI), including per capita values.
description.ms: Siri masa panjang keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) serta pendapatan nasional kasar (PNK) pada harga semasa, termasuk nilai per kapita.

methodology.en: Gross domestic product (GDP) is the total value of goods and services produced within that year, after deducting the cost of goods and services used in production, but before deducting the consumption of fixed capital. In Malaysia, GDP is estimated in compliance with the [System of National Accounts (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf). Gross national income (GNI) is derived as GDP plus net factor incomes from abroad. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).
methodology.ms: Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) adalah jumlah nilai barangan dan perkhidmatan yang dihasilkan dalam tahun tersebut, selepas ditolak kos barangan dan perkhidmatan yang digunakan dalam proses pengeluaran, tetapi sebelum ditolak penggunaan modal tetap. Di Malaysia, anggaran KDNK dihasilkan selaras dengan [Sistem Akaun Nasional (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf). Pendapatan nasional kasar (PNK) didefinisikan sebagai KDNK tambah pendapatan faktor bersih dari luar negara. Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).

caveats.en:
Values for 1954 are not available as data for that year was not collected. GDP and GNI values for 2022 and 2023 may be revised in future releases. Furthermore, per capita values will be revised in parallel with any published revisions to [Malaysia's population data](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/population_malaysia). Finally, it should be noted that the scope of 'national' changes across the time series, as follows:
 - Values for 1947-53 refer to the Federation of Malaya and Singapore.
 - Values for 1955-59 refer to the Federation of Malaya (which included Singapore).
 - Values for 1960-62 refer to Peninsular Malaysia only (i.e. excluding Singapore).
 - Values from 1963 onwards refer to Malaysia as currently defined, including Sabah and Sarawak, and excluding Singapore.
caveats.ms:
Angka bagi 1954 tidak tersedia kerana data bagi tahun tersebut tidak dikumpulkan. Angka KDNK dan PNK bagi 2022 dan 2023 mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan akan datang. Tambahan, angka per kapita akan disemak semula selaras dengan mana-mana semakan kepada [data penduduk Malaysia](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/data-catalogue/population_malaysia). Akhirnya, harus diambil perhatian bahawa definisi 'nasional' tidak sama sepanjang siri masa ini, khususnya:
 - Angka bagi 1947-53 merujuk kepada Persekutuan Tanah Melayu dan Singapura.
 - Angka bagi 1955-59 merujuk kepada Persekutuan Tanah Melayu (yang merangkumi Singapura pada masa tersebut)
 - Angka bagi 1960-62 merujuk kepada Semenanjung Malaysia sahaja (iaitu tidak termasuk Singapura).
 - Angka dari 1963 dan seterusnya merujuk kepada Malaysia seperti definisi moden, iaitu termasuk Sabah dan Sarawak, dan tidak termasuk Singapura.

title.en: Quarterly Nominal GDP by Expenditure Type
title.ms: KDNK Nominal Suku Tahunan mengikut Jenis Perbelanjaan

description.en: Quarterly gross domestic product (GDP) at current prices, by expenditure type.
description.ms: Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) suku tahunan pada harga semasa, mengikut jenis perbelanjaan.

methodology.en:
Gross domestic product (GDP) is the total value of goods and services produced within that year, after deducting the cost of goods and services used in production, but before deducting the consumption of fixed capital. In Malaysia, GDP is estimated in compliance with the [System of National Accounts (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

In general, GDP can be measured via 3 approaches, namely production, expenditure, and income. Because the measurement employs double entry accounting, the overall value must be the same across all 3 approaches. However, the different approaches allow GDP to be analysed in different ways. The GDP estimates in this dataset were produced using the expenditure method (C + I + G + X - M), which allows insight into who is buying the output of the Malaysian economy; households, businesses, government, or other countries. The values were measured at current prices, i.e. without removing price effects. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) adalah jumlah nilai barangan dan perkhidmatan yang dihasilkan dalam tahun tersebut, selepas ditolak kos barangan dan perkhidmatan yang digunakan dalam proses pengeluaran, tetapi sebelum ditolak penggunaan modal tetap. Di Malaysia, anggaran KDNK dihasilkan selaras dengan [Sistem Akaun Nasional (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

Secara am, KDNK boleh diukur melalui 3 kaedah, iaitu pengeluaran, perbelanjaan, dan pendapatan. Memandangkan bahawa pengukurannya menggunakan sistem perakaunan catatan bergu, angka keseluruhan mesti sama bagi ketiga-tiga kaedah tersebut. Namun, kaedah yang berbeza itu membolehkan analisis KDNK yang berlainan. Anggaran KDNK dalam set data ini dihasilkan melalui kaedah perbelanjaan (C + I + G + X - M), yang membolehkan analisis tentang siapa yang membeli pengeluaran ekonomi Malaysia; sama ada isi rumah, perniagaan, kerajaan, atau negara lain. Angka-angka diukur pada harga semasa, iaitu tidak mengeluarkan kesan harga. Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).

caveats.en: Values for 2022, 2023 and 2024 may be revised in future releases. Furthermore, the sum of GDP for all expenditure types may not always equal to the values for overall GDP because of independent rounding to one decimal place. However, the differences are not obvious.
caveats.ms: Angka bagi 2022, 2023 dan 2024 mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan akan datang. Tambahan, hasil tambah nilai KDNK bagi semua jenis perbelanjaan mungkin tidak sentiasa sama dengan nilai KDNK keseluruhan kerana pembundaran secara bebas. Walau bagaimanapun, perbezaan ini tidak ketara.

OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on GDP](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/gdp) which enables you to explore Malaysia's GDP data interactively.
publications.ms: [Keluaran Dalam Negeri Kasar, ST1 2025](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/gdp_2025-q1), edisi terkini bagi statistik KDNK suku tahunan yang diterbitkan oleh DOSM. OpenDOSM sendiri juga membekalkan [_dashboard_ KDNK](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/dashboard/gdp) yang membolehkan anda menerokai data KDNK Malaysia secara interaktif.

description.en: Quarterly gross domestic product (GDP) at current prices for the 5 main economic sectors.
description.ms: Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) suku tahunan pada harga semasa bagi 5 sektor ekonomi utama.

methodology.en:
Gross domestic product (GDP) is the total value of goods and services produced within that year, after deducting the cost of goods and services used in production, but before deducting the consumption of fixed capital. In Malaysia, GDP is estimated in compliance with the [System of National Accounts (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

In general, GDP can be measured via 3 approaches, namely production, expenditure, and income. Because the measurement employs double entry accounting, the overall value must be the same across all 3 approaches. However, the different approaches allow GDP to be analysed in different ways. The GDP estimates in this dataset were produced using the production method, also known as the value added approach, which allows insight into the specific contribution of each economic sector. The values are measured at current prices, i.e. without removing price effects. For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) adalah jumlah nilai barangan dan perkhidmatan yang dihasilkan dalam tahun tersebut, selepas ditolak kos barangan dan perkhidmatan yang digunakan dalam proses pengeluaran, tetapi sebelum ditolak penggunaan modal tetap. Di Malaysia, anggaran KDNK dihasilkan selaras dengan [Sistem Akaun Nasional (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

Secara am, KDNK boleh diukur melalui 3 kaedah, iaitu pengeluaran, perbelanjaan, dan pendapatan. Memandangkan bahawa pengukurannya menggunakan sistem perakaunan catatan bergu, angka keseluruhan mesti sama bagi ketiga-tiga kaedah tersebut. Namun, kaedah yang berbeza itu membolehkan analisis KDNK yang berlainan. Anggaran KDNK dalam set data ini dihasilkan melalui kaedah pengeluaran, ataupun kaedah nilai ditambah, yang membolehkan perincian sumbangan setiap sektor ekonomi kepada KDNK keseluruhan. Angka-angka diukur pada harga semasa, iaitu tidak mengeluarkan kesan harga. Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).

In Malaysia, GDP is estimated in compliance with the [System of National Accounts (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

In general, GDP can be measured via 3 approaches, namely production, expenditure, and income. Because the measurement employs double entry accounting, the overall value must be the same across all 3 approaches. However, the different approaches allow GDP to be analysed in different ways. The GDP estimates in this dataset were produced using the expenditure method (C + I + G + X - M), which allows insight into who is buying the output of the Malaysian economy; households, businesses, government, or other countries. The values were measured at constant 2015 prices, i.e. with price effects removed relative to a base year (2015 = 100). For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) adalah jumlah nilai barangan dan perkhidmatan yang dihasilkan dalam tahun tersebut, selepas ditolak kos barangan dan perkhidmatan yang digunakan dalam proses pengeluaran, tetapi sebelum ditolak penggunaan modal tetap. Di Malaysia, anggaran KDNK dihasilkan selaras dengan [Sistem Akaun Nasional (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

Secara am, KDNK boleh diukur melalui 3 kaedah, iaitu pengeluaran, perbelanjaan, dan pendapatan. Memandangkan bahawa pengukurannya menggunakan sistem perakaunan catatan bergu, angka keseluruhan mesti sama bagi ketiga-tiga kaedah tersebut. Namun, kaedah yang berbeza itu membolehkan analisis KDNK yang berlainan. Anggaran KDNK dalam set data ini dihasilkan melalui kaedah perbelanjaan (C + I + G + X - M), yang membolehkan analisis tentang siapa yang membeli pengeluaran ekonomi Malaysia; sama ada isi rumah, perniagaan, kerajaan, atau negara lain. Angka-angka diukur pada harga malar 2015, iaitu dengan mengeluarkan kesan harga berbanding tahun asas (2015 = 100). Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).

caveats.en: Values for 2022 and 2023 may be revised in future releases. Furthermore, the sum of GDP for all expenditure types may not always equal to the values for overall GDP because of independent rounding to one decimal place. However, the differences are not obvious.
caveats.ms: Angka bagi 2022 dan 2023 mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan akan datang. Tambahan, hasil tambah nilai KDNK bagi semua jenis perbelanjaan mungkin tidak sentiasa sama dengan nilai KDNK keseluruhan kerana pembundaran secara bebas. Walau bagaimanapun, perbezaan ini tidak ketara.

publications.en: [Gross Domestic Product, 1Q 2025](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/gdp_2025-q1), the latest edition of the quarterly GDP statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on GDP](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/gdp) which enables you to explore Malaysia's GDP data interactively.

title.ms: KDNK Sebenar Suku Tahunan mengikut Subsektor Ekonomi

description.en: Quarterly gross domestic product (GDP) at constant 2015 prices by economic subsector. The table provides a preview of the full dataset using the latest year's data only.
description.ms: Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) suku tahunan pada harga malar 2015 mengikut subsektor ekonomi. Jadual memberi pratonton kepada set data penuh dengan menggunakan data tahun terkini sahaja.

methodology.en:
Gross domestic product (GDP) is the total value of goods and services produced within that year, after deducting the cost of goods and services used in production, but before deducting the consumption of fixed capital. In Malaysia, GDP is estimated in compliance with the [System of National Accounts (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

In general, GDP can be measured via 3 approaches, namely production, expenditure, and income. Because the measurement employs double entry accounting, the overall value must be the same across all 3 approaches. However, the different approaches allow GDP to be analysed in different ways. The GDP estimates in this dataset were produced using the production method, also known as the value added approach, which allows insight into the specific contribution of each economic sector. The values were measured at constant 2015 prices, i.e. with price effects removed relative to a base year (2015 = 100). For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) adalah jumlah nilai barangan dan perkhidmatan yang dihasilkan dalam tahun tersebut, selepas ditolak kos barangan dan perkhidmatan yang digunakan dalam proses pengeluaran, tetapi sebelum ditolak penggunaan modal tetap. Di Malaysia, anggaran KDNK dihasilkan selaras dengan [Sistem Akaun Nasional (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

Secara am, KDNK boleh diukur melalui 3 kaedah, iaitu pengeluaran, perbelanjaan, dan pendapatan. Memandangkan bahawa pengukurannya menggunakan sistem perakaunan catatan bergu, angka keseluruhan mesti sama bagi ketiga-tiga kaedah tersebut. Namun, kaedah yang berbeza itu membolehkan analisis KDNK yang berlainan. Anggaran KDNK dalam set data ini dihasilkan melalui kaedah pengeluaran, ataupun kaedah nilai ditambah, yang membolehkan perincian sumbangan setiap sektor ekonomi kepada KDNK keseluruhan. Angka-angka diukur pada harga malar 2015, iaitu dengan mengeluarkan kesan harga berbanding tahun asas (2015 = 100). Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).

caveats.en: Values for 2022, 2023 and 2024 may be revised in future releases. Furthermore, the sum of GDP for all sectors may not always equal to the values for overall GDP because of independent rounding to one decimal place. However, the differences are not obvious.
caveats.ms: Angka bagi 2022, 2023 dan 2024 mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan akan datang. Tambahan, hasil tambah nilai KDNK bagi semua sektor mungkin tidak sentiasa sama dengan nilai KDNK keseluruhan kerana pembundaran secara bebas. Walau bagaimanapun, perbezaan ini tidak ketara.

title.ms: KDNK Sebenar Tahunan mengikut Negeri & Sektor Ekonomi

description.en: Annual state-level gross domestic product (GDP) at constant 2015 prices for the 5 main economic sectors.
description.ms: Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) tahunan peringkat negeri pada harga malar 2015 bagi 5 sektor ekonomi utama.

methodology.en:
Gross domestic product (GDP) is the total value of goods and services produced within that year, after deducting the cost of goods and services used in production, but before deducting the consumption of fixed capital. In Malaysia, GDP is estimated in compliance with the [System of National Accounts (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

In general, GDP can be measured via 3 approaches, namely production, expenditure, and income. Because the measurement employs double entry accounting, the overall value must be the same across all 3 approaches. However, the different approaches allow GDP to be analysed in different ways. The GDP estimates in this dataset were produced using the production method (also known as the value added approach), which allows insight into the specific contribution of each economic sector. For that reason, the results of the production approach are often referenced in economic writing as supply-side GDP. The values were measured at constant 2015 prices, i.e. with price effects removed relative to a base year (2015 = 100). For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Keluaran dalam negeri kasar (KDNK) adalah jumlah nilai barangan dan perkhidmatan yang dihasilkan dalam tahun tersebut, selepas ditolak kos barangan dan perkhidmatan yang digunakan dalam proses pengeluaran, tetapi sebelum ditolak penggunaan modal tetap. Di Malaysia, anggaran KDNK dihasilkan selaras dengan [Sistem Akaun Nasional (2008)](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sna_2008.pdf).

Secara am, KDNK boleh diukur melalui 3 kaedah, iaitu pengeluaran, perbelanjaan, dan pendapatan. Memandangkan bahawa pengukurannya menggunakan sistem perakaunan catatan bergu, angka keseluruhan mesti sama bagi ketiga-tiga kaedah tersebut. Namun, kaedah yang berbeza itu membolehkan analisis KDNK yang berlainan. Anggaran KDNK dalam set data ini dihasilkan melalui kaedah pengeluaran (juga dikenali sebagai kaedah nilai ditambah), yang membolehkan perincian sumbangan setiap sektor ekonomi kepada KDNK keseluruhan. Oleh itu, hasil daripada kaedah pengeluaran juga dirujuk dalam tulisan ekonomi sebagai KDNK dari segi penawaran (_supply-side GDP_). Angka-angka diukur pada harga malar 2015, iaitu dengan mengeluarkan kesan harga berbanding tahun asas (2015 = 100). Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila merujuk kepada [Nota Teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/technical-notes/gdp-technotes).

caveats.en:
There are several caveats to note:
- Values for W.P. Putrajaya are subsumed under values for W.P. Kuala Lumpur due to difficulty in separating the attribution of economic value.
- Values for 2022 and 2023 may be revised in future releases.
- The sum of GDP for all sectors may not always equal to the values for overall GDP because of independent rounding to one decimal place. However, the differences are not obvious.
caveats.ms:
Terdapat beberapa perkara yang perlu diberi perhatian:
- Nilai bagi W.P. Putrajaya dimasukkan bawah nilai W.P. Kuala Lumpur kerana kesukaran dalam membezakan punca nilai ekonomi.
- Angka bagi 2022 dan 2023 mungkin disemak semula dalam penerbitan akan datang.
- Hasil tambah nilai KDNK bagi semua sektor mungkin tidak sentiasa sama dengan nilai KDNK keseluruhan kerana pembundaran secara bebas. Walau bagaimanapun, perbezaan ini tidak ketara.

description.en: Annual greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by source.
description.ms: Pelepasan gas rumah hijau (GHG) tahunan mengikut sumber.

methodology.en: Official data on GHG emissions is compiled by the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainbility (NRES), following the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) guidelines for national greenhouse gas inventories. The GHG emissions data is derived from multiple sectors including energy, industrial processes, agriculture, waste, as well as land use, land-use change, and forestry (LULUCF). LULUCF data reflects both emissions and removals based on land management practices, contributing to the net emissions calculations.
methodology.ms: Statistik rasmi pelepasan GHG dirangka oleh Kementerian Sumber Asli dan Kelestarian Alam Sekitar (NRES) mengikut garis panduan Panel Antara Kerajaan Mengenai Perubahan Iklim (IPCC) untuk inventori pelepasan gas rumah hijau nasional. Data pelepasan GHG berpunca dari pelbagai sektor termasuk tenaga, pemprosesan industri, pertanian, sisa, serta guna tanah, perubahan guna tanah, dan perhutanan (LULUCF). Data LULUCF mencerminkan pelepasan dan penyingkiran berdasarkan amalan pengurusan tanah, menyumbang kepada pengiraan pelepasan bersih.

caveats.en: Data for 2020 and 2021 is provisional and subject to revision. Furthermore, no breakdown is provided for those years, i.e. only values for total emissions are provided.
caveats.ms: Data bagi 2020 dan 2021 belum lagi muktamat dan tertakluk kepada semakan semula. Selain itu, tiada pecahan disediakan untuk tahun-tahun tersebut, bermakna hanya nilai bagi pelepasan keseluruhan disediakan.

It should be noted that although LULUCF values can, in principle, be positive (representing emissions) or negative (representing removals), the values for Malaysia are all negative.

Harus diingati bahawa walaupun nilai LULUCF secara prinsipnya boleh positif (mewakili pelepasan) atau negatif (mewakili penyingkiran), nilai bagi Malaysia adalah semua negatif.

description.ms: [Apung] Jumlah pelepasan GHG dalam gigagram (Gg) CO₂ setara (CO₂e).

description.en: Mean gross monthly household expenditure by DUN constituency from 2019 to 2024.
description.ms: Purata dan penengah perbelajaan kasar bulanan isi rumah mengikut kawasan DUN dari 2019 hingga 2024.

methodology.en:
In general, data on household expenditure is difficult to tabulate, as it requires the correct definition of a statistical household, as well as the inclusion of all modes of expenditure. For this reason, it requires the use of a representative survey or census.

 In Malaysia, data on household expenditure is collected through the Household Expenditure and Expenditure Survey (HIES), which is conducted at least twice within any 5-year period. The data shown here was tabulated from household-level HIES records spanning 2019 to 2024 (the latest edition). For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [technical notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Secara am, data mengenai perbelanjaan isi rumah agak sukar untuk dihasilkan, kerana ia memerlukan definisi statistik yang tepat bagi isi rumah, serta data mengenai pelbagai mod perbelanjaan. Oleh itu, ia memerlukan penggunaan survei atau banci.

Di Malaysia, data mengenai perbelanjaan isi rumah dikumpul melalui Survei Perbelajaan dan Perbelanjaan Isi Rumah (HIES), yang dilaksanakan sekurang-kurangnya dua kali dalam mana-mana tempoh 5 tahun. Data yang dipaparkan di sini telah dihasilkan daripada rekod HIES peringkat isi rumah dari tahun 2019 hingga 2024 (edisi terkini). Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila rujuk kepada [nota teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).

caveats.en: This data presents nominal values, i.e. they have not been adjusted for inflation. Furthermore, DUN-level data is only published from 2019 (relative to [state-level data](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/hh_expenditure_state) which is available from 1970) as prior HIES samples were not sufficient to support DUN-level granularity.
caveats.ms: Data ini menunjukkan nilai nominal, iaitu mereka tidak diselaraskan untuk inflasi. Selain itu, data di peringkat DUN hanya diterbitkan mulai 2019 (berbanding dengan [data negeri](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/hh_expenditure_state) yang tersedia dari 1970) kerana sampel HIES sebelumnya tidak mencukupi untuk membolehkan pecahan mengikut kawasan DUN.

description.en: Mean and median monthly gross household income in Malaysia from 1970 to 2024.
description.ms: Purata dan penengah pendapatan kasar bulanan isi rumah di Malaysia dari 1970 hingga 2024.

methodology.en:
Data on individual salaries and wages [in the formal economy](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/formal-sector-wages) is easy to obtain from administrative records. However, data on household income is more difficult to tabulate, as it requires the correct definition of a statistical household, as well as the inclusion of non-salary sources of income such as property income, dividends, and interest. For this reason, it requires the use of a representative survey or census.

 In Malaysia, data on household income (as well as expenditure and access to basic amenities) is collected through the Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES), which is conducted at least twice within any 5-year period. The data shown here was tabulated from household-level HIES records spanning 1970 to 2024 (the latest edition). For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [technical notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Data mengenai gaji dan upah individu [dalam ekonomi formal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/dashboard/formal-sector-wages) mudah diperoleh daripada rekod pentadbiran. Sebaliknya, data mengenai pendapatan isi rumah lebih sukar untuk dihasilkan, kerana ia memerlukan definisi statistik yang tepat bagi isi rumah, serta sumber pendapatan bukan gaji seperti pendapatan hartanah, dividen, dan faedah. Oleh itu, ia memerlukan penggunaan survei atau banci.

Di Malaysia, data mengenai pendapatan isi rumah (serta perbelanjaan dan akses kepada kemudahan asas) dikumpul melalui Survei Pendapatan dan Perbelanjaan Isi Rumah (HIES), yang dilaksanakan sekurang-kurangnya dua kali dalam mana-mana tempoh 5 tahun. Data yang dipaparkan di sini telah dihasilkan daripada rekod HIES peringkat isi rumah dari tahun 1970 hingga 2024 (edisi terkini). Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, sila rujuk kepada [nota teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).

caveats.en:
This data presents nominal values, i.e. they have not been adjusted for inflation. Furthermore, given that the data is produced from surveys spanning over half a century, the following methodological changes should be noted:
 - Data for 1970 and 1974 refers to Peninsular Malaysia only. 1976 was the first year in which Sabah and Sarawak were included in the survey.
 - Data from 1989 onwards refers to Malaysian citizens only. Although non-citizens are also included in the surveys, the official statistics (which form the basis for national welfare policy) are based on citizens only.
caveats.ms:
Data ini menunjukkan nilai nominal, iaitu mereka tidak diselaraskan untuk inflasi. Selain itu, memandangkan bahawa data ini dihasilkan daripada survey yang menjangkau lebih dari setengah abad, perubahan metodologi berikut harus diberi perhatian:
 - Data untuk 1970 dan 1974 merujuk kepada Semenanjung Malaysia sahaja. Tahun 1976 adalah tahun pertama di mana Sabah dan Sarawak disekalikan dalam tinjauan.
 - Mulai 1989, data merujuk kepada warganegara Malaysia sahaja. Walaupun warga asing juga disekalikan dalam tinjauan, statistik rasmi (yang menjadi asas untuk dasar nasional) hanya berdasarkan warganegara sahaja.

publications.en: The [Household Income Survey Report, 2022](https://open.dosm.gov.my/hies/household_income_2022.pdf), the latest edition of the household income statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on household income](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/household-income-expenditure) which enables you to explore Malaysia's household income data interactively.
publications.ms: [Laporan Survei Pendapatan Isi Rumah, 2022](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/publications/hies/household_income_2022.pdf), edisi terkini bagi statistik pendapatan isi rumah yang diterbitkan oleh DOSM. OpenDOSM juga membekalkan [_dashboard_ pendapatan isi rumah](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/dashboard/household-income-expenditure) yang membolehkan anda menerokai data pendapatan isi rumah Malaysia secara interaktif.

Data on individual salaries and wages [in the formal economy](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/formal-sector-wages) is easy to obtain from administrative records. However, data on household income is more difficult to tabulate, as it requires the correct definition of a statistical household, as well as the inclusion of non-salary sources of income such as property income, dividends, and interest. The data shown here was tabulated from household-level HIES records spanning 1970 to 2024 (the latest edition). Data mengenai gaji dan upah individu [dalam ekonomi formal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/ms-MY/dashboard/formal-sector-wages) mudah diperoleh daripada rekod pentadbiran. Sebaliknya, data mengenai pendapatan isi rumah lebih sukar untuk dihasilkan, kerana ia memerlukan definisi statistik yang tepat bagi isi rumah, serta sumber pendapatan bukan gaji seperti pendapatan hartanah, dividen, dan faedah. This data presents nominal values, i.e. they have not been adjusted for inflation. Furthermore, given that the data is produced from surveys spanning over half a century, the following methodological changes should be noted:
 - Data for 1970 and 1974 refers to Peninsular Malaysia only. 1976 was the first year in which Sabah and Sarawak were included in the survey.
 - Data from 1989 onwards refers to Malaysian citizens only. Although non-citizens are also included in the surveys, the official statistics (which form the basis for national welfare policy) are based on citizens only
 - Kuala Lumpur was gazzeted as a Federal Territory on 1 February 1974. Accordingly, data for W.P. Kuala Lumpur is only available from 1976. Prior to that, data for residents of W.P. Kuala Lumpur was included under Selangor.
 - Labuan was gazetted as a Federal Territory on 16 April 1984. However, due to limitations in sampling, data for W.P. Labuan is only available from 2007. Prior to that, data for residents of W.P. Labuan was included under Sabah.
 - Putrajaya was gazzeted as a Federal Territory on 1 February 2001. However, due to limitations in sampling, data for W.P. Putrajaya is only available from 2007. Prior to that, data for residents of W.P. Putrajaya was included under Selangor.
caveats.ms:
Data ini menunjukkan nilai nominal, iaitu mereka tidak diselaraskan untuk inflasi. Selain itu, memandangkan bahawa data ini dihasilkan daripada survey yang menjangkau lebih dari setengah abad, perubahan metodologi berikut harus diberi perhatian:
 - Data untuk 1970 dan 1974 merujuk kepada Semenanjung Malaysia sahaja. Tahun 1976 adalah tahun pertama di mana Sabah dan Sarawak disekalikan dalam tinjauan.
 - Mulai 1989, data merujuk kepada warganegara Malaysia sahaja. Walaupun warga asing juga disekalikan dalam tinjauan, statistik rasmi (yang menjadi asas untuk dasar nasional) hanya berdasarkan warganegara sahaja.
 - Kuala Lumpur diwartakan sebagai Wilayah Persekutuan pada 1 Februari 1974. Oleh itu, data untuk W.P. Kuala Lumpur hanya tersedia mulai 1976. Sebelum itu, data untuk penduduk W.P. Kuala Lumpur adalah sebahagian daripada Selangor.
 Labuan diwartakan sebagai Wilayah Persekutuan pada 16 April 1984. Namun, disebabkan oleh kekangan dalam pengsampelan, data bagi W.P. Labuan hanya tersedia mulai 2007. Sebelum itu, data untuk penduduk W.P. Labuan adalah sebahagian daripada Sabah.
 - Putrajaya diwartakan sebagai Wilayah Persekutuan pada 1 Februari 2001. Namun, disebabkan oleh kekangan dalam pengsampelan, data bagi W.P. Putrajaya hanya tersedia mulai 2007. Sebelum itu, data untuk penduduk W.P. Putrajaya adalah sebahagian daripada Selangor.

description.en: Gini coefficient for Malaysia from 1970 to 2024.
description.ms: Pekali Gini untuk Malaysia dari 1970 hingga 2024.

methodology.en:
The primary Gini coefficient for Malaysia is computed based on the distribution of households' gross monthly income, where:
 - Gini coefficient values are bounded within 0 and 1, with higher values indicating greater income inequality.
 - A value of 0 indicates perfect equality (i.e. that every household has the same income).
 - A value of 1 indicates total inequality (i.e. that 1 household earns all the income while all others earn nothing).

Because the computation of the Gini coefficient relies on household income data, Malaysia's Gini coefficient statistics are produced and published together with statistics on household income derived from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES), which is conducted at least twice within any 5-year period. For full details on the methodology, especially the computation of the PLI and its evolution and nuances, please refer to the [technical notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Pekali Gini utama bagi Malaysia dihasilkan berdasarkan taburan pendapatan kasar bulanan isi rumah:
 - Nilai pekali Gini adalah antara 0 dengan 1.
 - Nilai 0 bermaksud kesamarataan total (iaitu semua isi rumah mempunyai pendapatan sama).
 - Nilai 1 bermaksud ketidaksamarataan total (iaitu 1 isi rumah mempunyai semua pendapatan di samping yang lain tidak mendapat apa-apa).

Oleh sebab penghasilan pekali Gini memerlukan data pendapatan isi rumah, statistik pekali Gini Malaysia dihasilkan dan diterbitkan bersama dengan statistik pendapatan isi rumah yang dihasilkan daripada Survei Pendapatan dan Perbelanjaan Isi Rumah (HIES), yang dilaksanakan sekurang-kurangnya dua kali dalam mana-mana tempoh 5 tahun. Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, terutamanya mengenai pengiraan PGK serta evolusi dan nuansanya, sila rujuk kepada [nota teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).

description.en: Poverty rates in Malaysia from 1970 to 2024.
description.ms: Kadar kemiskinan di Malaysia dari 1970 hingga 2024.

methodology.en:
In general, poverty is defined as having household income below a specific benchmark. Accordingly, statistics on poverty in Malaysia are produced and published together with statistics on household income derived from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES), which is conducted at least twice within any 5-year period. This dataset presents 3 definitions of poverty:
 1. **Absolute Poverty**: A household is considered to be in absolute poverty if their gross monthly household income is below the Poverty Line Income (PLI). This indicates that the household does not earn sufficient income to meet basic needs for a dignified life. 
 2. **Hardcore Poverty**: A household is considered to be in hardcore poverty if their gross monthly household income is below the Food Poverty Line Income (Food PLI). This indicates that the household does not earn sufficient income to meet basic calorie requirements. It should be noted that hardcore poverty is a subset of absolute poverty. 
 3. **Relative Poverty**: A household is considered to be in relative poverty if their gross monthly household income is below half the national median income. This measure is used to assess relative deprivation within the country, especially as absolute and hardcore poverty rates approach 0, as is the case for Malaysia.

 For full details on the methodology, especially the computation of the PLI and its evolution and nuances, please refer to the [technical notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Secara am, definisi kemiskinan adalah pendapatan isi rumah di bawah sesuatu aras pendapatan. Oleh itu, statistik mengenai kemiskinan di Malaysia dihasilkan dan diterbitkan bersama dengan statistik pendapatan isi rumah yang dihasilkan daripada Survei Pendapatan dan Perbelanjaan Isi Rumah (HIES), yang dilaksanakan sekurang-kurangnya dua kali dalam mana-mana tempoh 5 tahun. Set data ini memaparkan 3 definisi kemiskinan:
 1. **Kemiskinan Mutlak**: Sebuah isi rumah dianggap berada dalam kemiskinan mutlak jika pendapatan kasar bulanan isi rumah mereka berada di bawah Pendapatan Garis Kemiskinan (PGK). Ini menunjukkan bahawa isi rumah tersebut tidak mempunyai pendapatan yang cukup untuk memenuhi keperluan asas.
 2. **Kemiskinan Tegar**: Sebuah isi rumah dianggap berada dalam kemiskinan tegar jika pendapatan kasar bulanan isi rumah mereka berada di bawah Pendapatan Garis Kemiskinan Makanan (PGK Makanan). Ini menunjukkan bahawa isi rumah tersebut tidak mempunyai pendapatan yang cukup untuk memenuhi keperluan kalorie asas. Kemiskinan tegar adalah subset kepada kemiskinan mutlak.
 3. **Kemiskinan Relatif**: Sebuah isi rumah dianggap berada dalam kemiskinan relatif jika pendapatan kasar bulanan isi rumah mereka berada di bawah separuh pendapatan penengah nasional. Indikator ini digunakan untuk menganalisis ketersisihan relatif dalam negara, terutamanya apabila kadar kemiskinan mutlak dan tegar semakin mendekati kosong seperti mana yang berlaku di Malaysia.

 Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, terutamanya mengenai pengiraan PGK serta evolusi dan nuansanya, sila rujuk kepada [nota teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).

caveats.en:
Given that the data is produced from surveys spanning over half a century, the following methodological changes should be noted:
 - Data for 1970 and 1974 refers to Peninsular Malaysia only. 1976 was the first year in which Sabah and Sarawak were included in the survey.
 - Data from 1989 onwards refers to Malaysian citizens only. Although non-citizens are also included in the surveys, the official statistics (which form the basis for national welfare policy) are based on citizens only.
caveats.ms:
Memandangkan bahawa data ini dihasilkan daripada survey yang menjangkau lebih dari setengah abad, perubahan metodologi berikut harus diberi perhatian:
 - Data untuk 1970 dan 1974 merujuk kepada Semenanjung Malaysia sahaja. Tahun 1976 adalah tahun pertama di mana Sabah dan Sarawak disekalikan dalam tinjauan.
 - Mulai 1989, data merujuk kepada warganegara Malaysia sahaja. Walaupun warga asing juga disekalikan dalam tinjauan, statistik rasmi (yang menjadi asas untuk dasar nasional) hanya berdasarkan warganegara sahaja.

description.en: Poverty rates by DUN constituency from 2019 to 2024.
description.ms: Kadar kemiskinan mengikut kawasan DUN dari 2019 hingga 2024.

methodology.en:
In general, poverty is defined as having household income below a specific benchmark. Accordingly, statistics on poverty in Malaysia are produced and published together with statistics on household income derived from the Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES), which is conducted at least twice within any 5-year period. This dataset presents 2 definitions of poverty:
 1. **Absolute Poverty**: A household is considered to be in absolute poverty if their gross monthly household income is below the Poverty Line Income (PLI). This indicates that the household does not earn sufficient income to meet basic needs for a dignified life.
 2. **Relative Poverty**: A household is considered to be in relative poverty if their gross monthly household income is below half the national median income. This measure is used to assess relative deprivation within the district, especially as absolute and hardcore poverty rates approach 0, as is the case for Malaysia.

 For full details on the methodology, especially the computation of the PLI and its evolution and nuances, please refer to the [technical notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).
methodology.ms:
Secara am, definisi kemiskinan adalah pendapatan isi rumah di bawah sesuatu aras pendapatan. Oleh itu, statistik mengenai kemiskinan di Malaysia dihasilkan dan diterbitkan bersama dengan statistik pendapatan isi rumah yang dihasilkan daripada Survei Pendapatan dan Perbelanjaan Isi Rumah (HIES), yang dilaksanakan sekurang-kurangnya dua kali dalam mana-mana tempoh 5 tahun. Set data ini memaparkan 3 definisi kemiskinan:
 1. **Kemiskinan Mutlak**: Sebuah isi rumah dianggap berada dalam kemiskinan mutlak jika pendapatan kasar bulanan isi rumah mereka berada di bawah Pendapatan Garis Kemiskinan (PGK). Ini menunjukkan bahawa isi rumah tersebut tidak mempunyai pendapatan yang cukup untuk memenuhi keperluan asas.
 2 **Kemiskinan Relatif**: Sebuah isi rumah dianggap berada dalam kemiskinan relatif jika pendapatan kasar bulanan isi rumah mereka berada di bawah separuh pendapatan penengah daerah. Indikator ini digunakan untuk menganalisis ketersisihan relatif dalam negara, terutamanya apabila kadar kemiskinan mutlak dan tegar semakin mendekati kosong seperti mana yang berlaku di Malaysia.

 Untuk mendapat perincian metodologi yang penuh, terutamanya mengenai pengiraan PGK serta evolusi dan nuansanya, sila rujuk kepada [nota teknikal](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).

caveats.en: Data on hardcore poverty is not available at DUN constituency level. Furthermore, DUN-level data is only published from 2019 (relative to [state-level data](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/hh_poverty_state) which is available from 1970) as prior HIES samples were not sufficient to support DUN-level granularity.
caveats.ms: Data mengenai kadar kemiskinan tegar tidak dapat disediakan di peringkat DUN. Selain itu, data DUN hanya diterbitkan mulai 2019 (berbanding dengan [data negeri](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/hh_poverty_state) yang tersedia dari 1970) kerana sampel HIES sebelumnya tidak mencukupi untuk membolehkan pecahan mengikut kawasan DUN.
